title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
comment: Survey paper; 80 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://xaddwell.github.io/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Agent-Safety/
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAVER框架，系统综述自演化智能体的安全问题，指出安全风险源于合法经验状态在累积、泛化与跨情境复用后获得超出原有效条件的持久性、授权或范围。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型部署后参数固定，难以从新交互中学习，促使自演化智能体持续更新参数、记忆、工具、技能与工作流等可复用状态，这使得历史事件成为未来致因，安全问题的性质发生根本变化。
AI.method: 提出以状态转移为中心的SAVER框架，包含五个环节：Substrate定位可复用影响，Adaptation刻画其变化，Violation识别受损害的安全属性，Exposure标记失效可观测之处，Response评估遏制、修复或撤销。
AI.result: 综述发现失效并非必源于有害信息，合法状态在适应过程中扩展持久性、授权或范围即可变得不安全；现有工作对准入、检索、激活、暴露和局部遏制证据较强，但对后代修复及适应恢复后的评估证据不足。
AI.conclusion: 主张采用纵向评估，将不安全影响追溯至其起源转移，验证跨后代的修复效果，并检验其在持续演化下是否会重新出现。

title: Characterizing and Codifying Malware Sophistication
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, published at 2026 Intermountain Engineering, Technology and Computing (IETC)
summary: 'Sophisticated' is widely used to describe malware, yet it lacks a consistent definition within academic literature. While existing software quality and complexity metrics offer some insight into malware structure, they do not capture the broader adversarial and operational traits that contribute to real-world threat potential. This paper presents a systematization of existing approaches for assessing malware quality using static binary analysis. We define malware sophistication through a quality-focused lens by reinterpreting select characteristics from the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality standard, including reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and security, and evaluating their applicability to malware binaries. We identify which characteristics are both relevant to malware and measurable through static analysis, forming the basis for future frameworks that consistently assess malware sophistication when source code is unavailable or dynamic execution is infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了基于静态二进制分析的恶意软件质量评估方法，提出通过重新诠释ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准来定义恶意软件复杂度的思路。
AI.motivation: 学术界对'复杂(sophisticated)'一词刻画恶意软件缺乏统一定义，已有软件质量与复杂度指标无法涵盖真实威胁潜力所需的对抗性和操作性特征。
AI.method: 对现有静态二进制分析评估方法进行系统化梳理，从ISO/IEC 25010标准中重新诠释可靠性、可维护性、灵活性和安全性等质量特性，并评估其对恶意软件二进制的适用性。
AI.result: 识别出哪些质量特性既与恶意软件相关又可通过静态分析测量，为在无源代码或无法动态执行场景下构建一致的恶意软件复杂度评估框架奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为恶意软件复杂度评估提供了以质量为导向的统一视角和可测量特性的筛选依据，支持未来构建一致性的评估框架。

title: A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions
summary: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对单像素攻击（OPA）进行了PRISMA指导的系统综述，提出了多轴分类法，总结了算法、防御、可解释性及领域漏洞，并展望了未来研究方向与监管框架。
AI.motivation: 单像素攻击是深度学习对抗脆弱性的极端体现，但现有综述对其覆盖零散或浅显，缺乏统一、系统的梳理。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南，综合2017至2026年的高质量研究，构建涵盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具及领域特定漏洞的多轴分类体系。
AI.result: 分析揭示差分进化策略占主导，效率优化和显著性引导方法兴起，同时存在数据集多样性、迁移性和标准化评估的持续缺口；防御范式包括像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换和鲁棒训练，各有鲁棒性、不可感知性和计算开销的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本综述为理解、评估和缓解当代AI系统中的超稀疏对抗威胁奠定了全面基础，并指出选择性像素恢复、Transformer特定脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化和领域自适应防御等未来优先方向，同时提出强调鲁棒性测试、事件披露和AI安全治理的监管框架。

title: A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging
comment: Submitted to Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 7 pages, 0 figures, 2 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
summary: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). The optimizer was correct, but the verifier had already disclosed the answer. We replace solver-first evaluation with a support-gated verification contract. A clean reference map must first show repeated component exposure; a matched reference/current gate must then establish comparable runtime evidence; only afterward may an independently calibrated signal rule return a detection. In a preregistered heldout comprising 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows, 55/72 regime-component units passed the reference gate, 54/55 passed the runtime gate, and stable false admission was 0/20 represented components with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic predicted detection better than nominal fault-cell fraction. The main lesson is structural: verify evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector. Otherwise a stronger solver can merely certify a stronger verifier artifact.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示验证器若泄露目标信息会使求解器比较失效，并提出支持门控验证契约来确保证据资格与非泄露性。
AI.motivation: 智能体开发中常通过模拟器验证器比较提示、工具、策略和诊断算法，但若验证器的探针或谓词编码了目标身份，求解器比较会变得空洞，精确优化器可能看似有效而未解决真实歧义。
AI.method: 报告闭环节点决策代理的聚合轨迹调试器中的此类失败：精确最小命中集与传播感知贪心方法在开发案例中返回相同支持；审计发现精确锚点谓词产生植入对；移除锚点后评估恢复率；提出支持门控验证契约，要求参考图显示重复组件暴露、匹配参考/当前门建立可比运行时证据，由独立校准信号规则检测；在预注册保留集（1440案例，21600分区行）中测试。
AI.result: 精确MHS与贪心在12/12开发案例中返回相同支持，9/12中相同植入故障恢复；审计发现精确锚点谓词在9/9中产生植入对；移除锚点后整体植入对恢复8/9，硬探针单例对9/9匹配，传播后无残留冲突族0/9；保留集中55/72制度组件单元通过参考门，54/55通过运行时门，稳定错误接纳0/20，单侧精确95%上界0.1391；接纳单元中受影响干净流量比名义故障单元比例更好预测检测。
AI.conclusion: 主要教训是结构性的：在优化组件选择器之前，必须验证证据资格和非泄露性；否则更强的求解器只能证明更强的验证器伪影。

title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
summary: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该论文将反向项目反应理论（IRT）引入药物基因组学药物反应分析，以癌症类型为潜在“被试”（耐药能力）、药物为“项目”（规避难度），在GDSC2数据上估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性和药物层面的广谱活性，并验证其在缺失数据下的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 药物反应数据存在大量缺失和偏倚（MCAR、癌症偏倚、药物偏倚），简单平均难以稳健恢复潜在排序；作者希望用反向IRT在共享潜在尺度上同时估计癌症耐药性与药物活性，提升碎片化评估下的方法学稳健性。
AI.method: 将癌症类型视为具有耐药能力的潜在被试、药物视为具有规避难度的项目，构建反向IRT模型；应用于GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量；在四种缺失机制下验证潜在排序恢复，并与简单平均等方法比较；进行留出预测（Brier分数）、Bootstrap置信区间以及跨平台PRISM复制。
AI.result: 在60%缺失下，MCAR、癌症偏倚和药物偏倚稀疏情形中，反向IRT恢复全数据潜在排序优于简单平均，Delta-rho为+0.089至+0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中Brier分数最佳；Bootstrap显示28种癌症类型中19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复制方向一致率为82%，但秩相关较弱（rho=0.25）。
AI.conclusion: 反向IRT的主要贡献是在碎片化评估下提供方法学稳健性，而非普适的临床耐药排行榜；跨平台复制结果提示其排序一致性有限，应谨慎外推至临床。

title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出核心-尾部世界模型（CTWM），通过秩基记忆控制器分配提示预算，在保持状态覆盖的同时降低尾部预测误差和提示令牌消耗。
AI.motivation: 当前记忆系统仅以任务成功或令牌成本评估，忽略了有限上下文和重复检索下记忆使用的形状，即记忆集中于小核心而稀有状态形成长尾，导致预测误差累积。
AI.method: 进行保守尾部审计，发现记忆集中可复现但依赖策略；提出CTWM，一种基于秩的记忆控制器，使用单一指数τ分配提示预算并保留摘要尾部。
AI.result: 在合成图世界上，CTWM保持完整状态和转移覆盖，提示令牌减少5.9%，底部半尾部预测误差降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上令牌节省一致；在LongMemEval上令牌减少24.48%且总体准确率持平。
AI.conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也是实现令牌高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

title: The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Includes formal proofs, transition taxonomy, and benchmark schema appendices. Reference verifier and reproducible evaluation artifacts available at https://github.com/openkedge/cctbench
summary:
Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions.
  IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出认知连续性测试（CCT），用于验证持久AI代理的状态转移声明，并构建IdentityLineageBench基准进行合成测试。
AI.motivation: 持久AI代理会修订信念、整合记忆并更换执行基底，但相似后继状态可能对应不同授权程度的转移声明，合法开发也可能大幅改变状态，因此需要一种策略相对的验证机制。
AI.method: CCT基于范围权限、来源、确定性应用、语义谓词和候选持久化收据，区分已验证可接受性、肯定违规和未解决的必需证据；构建了包含24个生成转移族的IdentityLineageBench，使用参考后解决验证器、词法状态相似度和仅谱系诊断基线进行对比，并加入签名对抗回归。
AI.result: 参考验证器匹配全部576个规范留出标签；词法相似度和谱系基线分别接受60.0%和80.0%的无效样本；18000次有效路径研究显示默认中位数为6.21毫秒。
AI.conclusion: CCT实现了合成合规性验证，但未测量实际模型迁移，部署还需额外的激活与恢复义务。

title: How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?
summary: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Adam优化器与自然梯度下降（NGD）的几何关系，将Adam完整更新规则视为对角经验Fisher近似，并测量其几何偏差。
AI.motivation: Adam作为深度学习标准优化器，其与自然梯度下降的几何关系尚存未解问题，需要量化Adam对真实NGD的几何偏离。
AI.method: 采用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归和非凸小型神经网络四种损失景观上，测量Adam（含动量）与真实NGD的几何偏差，并比较改进经验Fisher（iEF）与标准经验Fisher（EF）的路径稳定性。
AI.result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖上下文：良态下偏差低，病态下显著上升，神经网络中错位达约10^3；更高几何漂移与初始优化变慢相关，但不影响最终目标最小化；iEF比EF路径更稳定，EF常振荡或发散。
AI.conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非紧密跟踪自然梯度路径。

title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

AI.tldr: 提出FedCausalCompose因果世界模型框架，论证模块化LLM智能体需跨模块接口干预响应证据，而非仅拟合观测轨迹。
AI.motivation: 标准世界模型拟合观测轨迹，无法区分支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介或隐藏触发因素，因而在干预时规划中产生不可消除的干预误差。
AI.method: 构建FedCausalCompose框架，利用局部动作的干预-响应证据恢复跨模块接口；分析未阻断后门路径下的干预误差，并检验接口恢复与覆盖度的关系；在诊断性智能体环境中测试因果接口预测。
AI.result: 在结构化工具环境中因果接口帮助最大，API签名暴露前置条件和下游效应；对话与叙事环境常忽略原始边列表，除非有简短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。
AI.conclusion: 因果世界模型在LLM智能体中有效的条件是：跨模块接口既统计可识别，又在动作时以智能体可用的形式呈现。

title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
summary: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个可复现教学实验比较图像与文本分类中的对抗逃逸攻击：MNIST上CNN对FGSM/PGD脆弱，而SMS垃圾邮件分类中DistilBERT对预设扰动较稳健。
AI.motivation: 探究对抗脆弱性是否因模态而异，并强调鲁棒性不能由干净准确率推断，需实证检验。
AI.method: 实验一：紧凑卷积网络训练MNIST，实施白盒FGSM与PGD攻击，并尝试位深缩减防御；实验二：DistilBERT微调SMS Spam Collection，施加字符替换、空白噪声和良性后缀等预定义扰动序列。
AI.result: MNIST干净准确率98.63%；FGSM下ε=0.15降至60.20%、ε=0.30降至1.72%；PGD下降至32.47%和0.41%，位深缩减仅部分恢复。DistilBERT干净准确率98.75%、F1为94.96%，但扰动仅造成多数样例概率小幅偏移，未出现spam到ham的翻转。
AI.conclusion: 对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态：图像实验是明确的逃逸演示，文本实验为受控鲁棒性评估；鲁棒性必须通过经验测试而非从干净准确率推断。

title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
summary: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

AI.tldr: 通过消融实验系统分析频率坍缩注意力中滤波器的关键性质，发现DC/Nyquist成分有害，最优单尺度带宽为σ≈2并中心在段尺度，可允许的墨西哥帽滤波器优于高斯滤波器，且窄带滤波器免受FFT泄漏影响。
AI.motivation: 频率坍缩注意力用带通滤波内积替代Q/K点积取得显著提升，但何种滤波器形状最优及其原因尚不明确。
AI.method: 在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，检验五个关于滤波器性质的假设：DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率和多尺度覆盖。
AI.result: （1）DC和Nyquist成分主动有害（验证损失约2.0，等效于相位随机化），确认振荡带通结构必不可少；（2）最优单尺度带宽为σ≈2 bins，中心在段落尺度（约70个token），相对BASE-DOT获得+1.15 nats的净增益；（3）在相同尺度下，可允许滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽DOG m=2）优于不可允许的高斯滤波器，并对双边FFT泄漏提供部分保护；（4）双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增加——窄带滤波器（gap > +4）干净，宽带滤波器（gap < +2）泄漏；（5）字符尺度上的因果时域Morlet无法击败BASE-DOT（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%），促使在配套的MorletQK论文中进行词级实验。
AI.conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力场景（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因为训练和推理时均可获得全序列上下文；自回归生成需要因果频谱变体如MorletQK（解码器式，如GPT）。

title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures. Engineering validation and descriptive pilot. Public artifacts: https://github.com/praxa-labs/praxa-benchmarks/releases/tag/preprint-v1.4.0
summary: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

AI.tldr: 提出Praxa智能体框架，通过显式状态管理（准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账、审核晋升）使权限到效果的转换可测试，但当前证据仅支持架构贡献，未证明生产效益或安全性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体能够提议和执行动作，但提议、权威、调度、经验证的外部效果和上线推广是不同的声明，需要显式区分和验证。
AI.method: Praxa框架通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账和审核晋升显式表示状态；报告四个证据通道：仓库本地审计、Terminal-Bench试点、协调代理开发对比、部署配置证据。
AI.result: 审计通过1027/1027单元测试和89/89 Workerd测试，覆盖363个源文件，但缺少原始记录；Terminal-Bench试点中基线和可靠性层各通过17/36，可靠性层多耗37.49%输入和50.73%输出令牌；协调代理对比中候选方案完成180/180，令牌少37.11%，成本低33.84%，步骤少11.63%，但未证明质量提升；部署证据显示有界反射、召回核算等路径，无生产效果提升。
AI.conclusion: Praxa的贡献是证据绑定架构，使权限到效果转换显式可测试；当前证据未建立对抗安全、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

title: Intrusion Detection for Agentic Processes: Evidence-Based Runtime Monitoring
summary: Agent deployments increasingly combine language-model inference with retrieval, delegation, tool execution, external-system access, and human approval. Security-relevant deviations can therefore emerge across an evolving process rather than in one isolated input or action. Building on the author's earlier black-box architecture for agentic processes and the subsequent evidence-claim model, this paper proposes an Agentic-Process Intrusion Detection System (A-IDS), an evidence-aware security interpretation layer for runtime intrusion detection whose monitored object is the agentic process itself. A-IDS compares evidence-supported observations with a governed and versioned expectation baseline for workflow state, authorization, communication, and mandatory events. Its conceptual contribution combines dynamically due governed expectations, visibility separated from three-valued matching, explicit unresolved observation states, and bounded findings that separate evidentiary status from operational impact. The model further identifies the monitoring plane itself as an attack surface when adversarial content reaches semantic evidence producers through otherwise legitimate observation paths. Some observations may be produced outside the operational agent's self-report path, but the model does not assume complete observability or universally trustworthy capture. Prompt injection is treated both as an input-security problem and as a possible origin of later process deviations and cross-agent influence paths. A-IDS does not infer malicious intent from anomalous behavior, does not treat an unobserved event as proof of non-occurrence, and does not claim a new anomaly detector, temporal logic, or provenance model. The contribution is conceptual: it does not validate an implementation, demonstrate empirical detection performance, establish causal attribution, or provide an enforcement mechanism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出A-IDS（智能体过程入侵检测系统），一种基于证据感知的安全解释层，以智能体过程本身为监控对象，通过对比证据支撑的观测与受治理的版本化期望基线来检测运行时偏差。
AI.motivation: 智能体部署日益融合语言模型推理与检索、委托、工具执行、外部系统访问及人工审批，安全相关偏差可能在整个演化过程中涌现，而非局限于单一输入或动作；同时监控平面本身在对抗性内容通过合法观测路径到达语义证据生产者时也可能成为攻击面。
AI.method: A-IDS对比证据支撑的观测与受治理且版本化的期望基线（涵盖工作流状态、授权、通信和强制事件）；概念贡献包括动态到期受治理期望、可见性与三值匹配分离、显式未解决观测状态，以及区分证据状态与运行影响的有界发现。
AI.result: 该工作为概念性贡献，未验证实现、未展示实证检测性能、未建立因果归因、也未提供强制执行机制；模型不假设完全可观测或普遍可信的采集，且提示注入既被视为输入安全问题，也被视为后续过程偏差与跨智能体影响路径的可能来源。
AI.conclusion: A-IDS不因异常行为推断恶意意图，不将未观测事件视为未发生的证据，也不声称提出新的异常检测器、时序逻辑或溯源模型；其贡献在于概念层面，明确了智能体过程监控中的证据状态与运行影响分离及未解决观测状态等关键设计原则。

title: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
summary: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出结合强化学习多示例学习、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络的多目标框架，用于学生风险预测，但超网络扩展出现模式崩溃，偏好权重无法系统控制公平性与性能的权衡。
AI.motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现需要兼顾准确性与透明性以支持有效干预，同时人口统计信息会引入不公平预测风险，因此需要可控的多目标公平建模方法。
AI.method: 采用强化学习驱动的多示例学习（RL-MIL）将学生表示为弱标注交互包，由RL智能体选择信息性实例进行分类；并评估两种超网络变体，以用户定义的偏好标量连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡，同时结合对抗去偏。
AI.result: RL-MIL基线分类性能较强，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式崩溃：改变偏好权重对预期的公平性-性能前沿几乎无系统性移动。失败原因包括目标主导、条件机制中梯度传播弱，以及动态生成参数间的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 公平目标可纳入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件化不能保证可控的多目标行为；稳健的公平RL-MIL需要显式的梯度平衡、目标分离和稳定性分析机制。

title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
summary: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过固定证据与候选答案、仅改变推理者传递给验证者的理由，诊断其作为验证消息的作用，发现忠实理由几乎不提升答案准确率，而损坏理由会显著改变支持判断。
AI.motivation: 角色分工式问答流水线中，推理者向验证者传递理由，但尚不清楚这种消息传递带来的是更好的答案、更强的支持评估，还是新的失败面。
AI.method: 提出消息干预诊断：固定证据和候选答案，仅改变跨推理者-验证者边界的理由；在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA样本上，以DeepSeek作为生成器和验证者；并采用盲验证提示和显式理由检查提示，辅以人工审计及跨模型与任务边界检查。
AI.result: 忠实理由相比无理由几乎不增加答案准确率；损坏理由强烈改变支持判断。盲提示下，无害改写仅使支持变化0–2.5%，损坏理由变化10–22%；显式检查提示放大至34–55%。最终答案变化较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案变化。人工审计中，42个有效损坏有16个为损坏过度信任案例，盲人拒绝或标记不明确10个中被模型接受的损坏理由中的9个。
AI.conclusion: 理由共享应被评估为一种验证消息机制，而不仅仅是通向更高答案准确率的途径。

title: Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出Locket框架，通过在LLM生成中嵌入基于键控入口令牌的细粒度访问控制，以LoRA适配器实现隐私保护与知识访问的平衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在隐私敏感领域部署时存在记忆和泄露个人身份信息（PII）的风险，现有防御难以同时兼顾模型效用、隐私保护和微调私有知识的访问。
AI.method: Locket训练多个轻量级LoRA适配器，每个编码不同访问策略（完全揭示、PII掩码部分脱敏、指定差分隐私级别揭示）；紧凑门控模块通过序列级硬路由将学习到的键控入口令牌关联到唯一LoRA适配器，有效令牌作为授权密钥解锁私有知识，无效或缺失令牌则触发隐私保护适配器进行脱敏或净化；兼容现成LLM，支持可扩展部署。
AI.result: 在Enron、ECHR、Yelp数据集及Qwen3（1.7B/8B）、Llama-3.2（1B/3B）、Gemma-2-2B等模型上评估，提供正确令牌时困惑度与无防御原始数据微调相当；令牌缺失或无效时显著减少PII泄露，效用和困惑度与强基线防御持平。
AI.conclusion: Locket能有效嵌入策略驱动的访问控制，在保持模型效用和隐私保护的同时，实现对私有知识的授权访问，满足监管与隐私要求。

title: Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs
summary: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试短多项式程序能否替代LLM中的SFU操作，并在GB200上评估性能与训练效果。
AI.motivation: GPU各代在矩阵、特殊函数和内存管线的扩展速率不同，导致核瓶颈随硬件演进转移；FlashAttention-4在Blackwell上暴露了注意力中的不平衡，因此探索用短多项式加速其他SFU操作。
AI.method: 在FP16下对比原生PyTorch与打包FMA程序（L2与HBM驻留工作集）；在四个GB200集成任务（密集SiLU、tanh-softcapped注意力、sigmoid注意力、路由专家SwiGLU）中用3/4次BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU，程序结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入和消费核内打包算术。
AI.result: 隔离路径在L2提升1.19–2.19倍，HBM提升1.00–1.70倍；完整训练步吞吐分别提升2.7%（密集SiLU）、2.9%（tanh-softcapped注意力）、8.0%（路由专家SwiGLU）；sigmoid注意力替换使完整注意力前向提升7.4%，完整GPU步提升0.3%；在约1000亿token时，四个任务最终平滑训练损失差为-0.107至+0.079。
AI.conclusion: 短多项式程序可有效加速LLM中的SFU操作并提升训练吞吐，且对模型行为影响在可接受范围内。

title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
comment: Preprint. under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 15 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
summary: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

AI.tldr: 研究检验现成小语言模型（SLM）能否达到实践者设定的微任务阈值，发现16个配置全部不合格，且量化不会改变结论，差距主要取决于模型规模。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架希望用SLM处理前沿大模型规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次），因此需要验证现成SLM是否满足实践者定义的阈值。
AI.method: 构建含4个微任务的基准，使用固定提示和自动指标，每个任务预设阈值τ并采用置信区间感知的合格规则；对Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B在FP16、贪心、单一冻结提示、无调优下进行扫描；用logprob决策阈值诊断区分能力缺陷与解码阈值问题（4种状态）；测试4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）的影响；在Llama-3.x上复现；进行τ扫描和提示措辞鲁棒性检验。
AI.result: 16个配置（4任务×4模型）全部不合格；量化损害取决于模型规模，未能使任何配置合格；差距更多随模型规模而非精度变化；在Llama-3.x上12/12不合格；对锚点选择和提示措辞鲁棒（原始加3个中性改写共0/112合格）。
AI.conclusion: 实际建议是将SLM置于满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达阈值处使用SLM；例如4B重排序器在BM25短名单上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身仍未认证合格。

title: Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing
summary: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.

AI.tldr: 提出一种锚定声明的执行契约，联合绑定用户所见声明、其精确来源片段、产生该声明的有序执行前缀，以及执行时观察到的源版本与访问状态，并分离完整性平面与可插拔支持平面。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体虽能展示引用与执行日志，但缺少对关键关联的审计：用户看到的声明是否就是已提交执行所发出、且被引用来源支持的声明。有效引用与有效轨迹可各自形式正确，却被跨声明、动作、运行或源版本移植。
AI.method: 定义锚定声明的执行契约，每条收据包含发射锚点（确定性定位已提交答案或承载声明的动作中的声明）、源标识符、偏移、哈希、引文及域分离执行承诺；确定性完整性验证器在接入语义或任务标签前重建这些绑定，并将完整性平面与可插拔支持平面分离。契约暴露七个可独立测试属性：声明-发射绑定、源绑定、有序执行绑定、预言机分离、持久对象重放、执行重跑一致性、版本/访问绑定。
AI.result: 在1,280次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测出1,275次替换（0.9961）；移除任一目标属性后其攻击检测率降至0.0156-0.0625。在独立裁决的384对划分上，冲突感知支持守卫达到F1 0.8865、误接受0.0729；在未见失败族上分别为0.8679与0.0938。
AI.conclusion: 该契约能有效检测跨对象声明替换，且结构性有效不应作为蕴含的代理；完整性平面与支持平面分离后，支持判定在独立划分与未见失败族上保持较高F1与较低误接受率。

title: SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials
comment: 22 pages, Code and pretrained models available at: https://github.com/amirhoseinazarpour/SW-KAN
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SW-KAN，利用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式构建KAN，解决多项式KAN的域不匹配问题，实现精度与效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 原始KAN计算开销大，多项式KAN变体存在无界实数输入与正交多项式有界/半无限支撑之间的域不匹配问题。
AI.method: 采用定义在半无限域(0,∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式，引入平滑的tanh指数映射稳定桥接域差距，并利用数值稳定的三项递推在O(N)内计算展开。
AI.result: 在图像分类和连续函数逼近任务中，SW-KAN取得更优的精度-效率权衡，在降维和有限数据等资源受限条件下表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: SW-KAN优于现有多项式KAN基线，能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数，适用于资源受限场景下的高效函数逼近与分类。

title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
summary: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

AI.tldr: 论文将PRM剪枝片段嫁接（PPFG）作为跨轨迹步骤级迁移的最低成本操作化方案，在特定操作点测试其效果。
AI.motivation: 并行思维链中的多样性崩溃促使推理时干预，但先前片段嫁接工作仅在附加补偿条件下报告增益，缺乏对机制本身的隔离验证。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Math-Shepherd上，对完整MATH500（n=500，三个种子）测试PPFG的停滞和随机目标变体，并与独立并行CoT基线比较；通过四桶分类分析322个注入事件，并进行随机对照、跨模型/基准/PRM复现及等价性检验。
AI.result: PPFG在所有测量轴上与基线统计不可区分；仅14%注入事件针对真正挣扎的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或PRM平台期链上；随机对照在2.4倍触发率下同样无差异；结果在三个基础LM、六个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描中复现；两单侧检验在十二个Qwen/LLaMA单元上提升为零等价；事后预言机将任何逐问题增益上界限制在+0.13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PPFG在测试操作点下无效，该惰性非启发式特定；贡献了建立推理时机制零假设的等价性测试模板，所有声明均限定于其测试操作点。

title: UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation
summary: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .

AI.tldr: 提出UnifiedAttack基准与协同劫持框架，评估并利用LMM跨模态协同生成有害内容的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: LMM向原生统一架构演进，文本与图像协同可产生超越单模态的协同危害，现有安全评估未关注跨模态协同带来的危害增益。
AI.method: 构建UnifiedAttack基准，含多模态潜力样本与合成虚假信息查询子集；提出协同劫持框架，包含In-Context Reskinning（ICR，用少样本学习将对抗意图包装为无害虚拟外壳以规避安全过滤）和Cognitive Planning Injection（CPI，强制先规划后执行，利用模型对逻辑一致性的内在驱动力劫持推理路径）。
AI.result: 在先进架构上评估表明，UnifiedAttack能持续绕过现代对齐机制，实现有害多模态内容的同步生成。
AI.conclusion: 统一模型的结构化有用性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性武器化，亟需面向协同生成任务的逻辑感知防御。

title: Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining
summary:
Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global 
vfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local 
vfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine 
vfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

AI.tldr: 针对FP4张量核心中量化开销抵消加速收益的问题，提出格式感知融合，联合设计量化生产者、缩放域与消费者布局，在Llama-3 8B预训练中实现高吞吐并评估训练损失。
AI.motivation: FP4张量核心虽能加速矩阵乘法，但缩放计算、操作数打包、布局构建及反向状态保存等开销可能抵消收益，因此需要协同设计量化与执行路径。
AI.method: 提出格式感知融合，为mxfp、全局nvfp和协作线程阵列局部nvfp分别联合设计量化生产者、缩放域与消费者布局；使用bfloat16输出投影和编译交叉熵，对Llama-3系列8B模型进行1600亿token预训练，并采用行梯度随机舍入的mxfp及固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理。
AI.result: 同加速器对比中，bfloat16和Transformer Engine nvfp达到18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快自定义路径达37.9K；mxfp方案达37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点比原始bfloat16高2.11%；Transformer Engine配方含四个最终bfloat16块时，比bfloat16高0.87%，达27.1K tokens/s/GPU。
AI.conclusion: FP4结果取决于缩放契约、操作数和执行路径的联合作用；下游任务排名与训练损失排名不一致，表明需综合评估FP4训练效果。

title: Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization
summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 该论文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，提出GAP-DPO算法，通过效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择与逐轮重新生成来控制分布偏移，在个性化文本生成任务上优于标准DPO变体。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM需使生成行为对齐用户特定偏好而非总体质量。DPO虽稳定，但在个性化场景下效果关键取决于偏好对如何选择；现有方法多采用似然极值等启发式准则，使优化与显式用户效用解耦，可能导致个性化退化。
AI.method: 分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题。发现离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新从纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新。据此提出GAP-DPO：迭代算法，进行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮重新生成控制分布偏移。
AI.result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均持续优于标准DPO变体。
AI.conclusion: 梯度对齐是个性化偏好优化的统一原则；偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
comment: 41 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables, and 1 algorithm; includes formal proofs and external runtime adapter evidence
summary:
Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest.
  Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification.
  An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.

AI.tldr: 论文提出授权继承机制，确保自修改AI代理在替换、分叉和回滚时，权限在单亲生成森林的活动前沿上守恒。
AI.motivation: 现有按继承者授权的方案无法约束代理群体，导致配额重复、权限合并、祖先切割后仍存活或晋升时重叠等问题。
AI.method: 定义外部协议，为每代绑定清单、根、唯一父代、完整谱系和种群序列；采用分阶段预留、分区验证、原子提交等机制；在完全中介等假设下证明安全属性。
AI.result: 可执行评估覆盖32个注册决策，64/64重放，独立检查器接受64条原始轨迹并拒绝28/28语义变异体；12/12配置文件不变量、16/16崩溃切割、32/32竞争调度通过；两个外部适配器复现所有决策。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了针对注册受保护效应的授权继承机制的有效性。

title: "very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在言语不确定性量化上与人类的差异，并提出一种基于优化的算法METHODNAME，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记的最优概率映射，以可靠地量化LLM不确定性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM不确定性量化多依赖似然或一致性信号，而人类通过言语标记（如“可能”“大概”）表达不确定性，这反映元认知监控与知识边界。作者希望探究LLM与人类在言语不确定性量化上的分歧，并验证言语标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。
AI.method: 从心理学和决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料库，将LLM与人类基准对比；提出METHODNAME优化算法，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记到概率质量的最优映射，以最好地解释经验正确性，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。
AI.result: 观察到LLM编码言语不确定性的数值水平与人类存在显著差异；METHODNAME能够发现每个言语标记应传达的概率质量，实现人类与LLM在标记层面的置信语义直接比较，并揭示言语表达中的系统性置信差异。
AI.conclusion: 言语标记可用于可靠量化LLM不确定性，METHODNAME提供了一种无需重复采样的优化框架，有助于解耦人类与LLM在言语不确定性表达上的不匹配，并揭示系统性置信差异。

title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures plus a graphical abstract; includes benchmark prompts, scoring rubric, and per-prompt scores. Code: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok
summary: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

AI.tldr: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源、在研究者本地运行的 AI 科研助手，通过科学脚手架、Living Lab Notebook 和独立行为日志三项设计，在跨学科研究任务中的科学质量与研究执行上领先两个托管平台。
AI.motivation: 现有聊天助手或通用编码代理缺乏科研专用结构，且模型常出现过度声称（overclaiming）问题，需要让主张可核查而非仅靠限制模型行为。
AI.method: 研究者自带模型（本地或托管），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；每项目为普通文件夹；内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、数据目录、评审与写作角色；维护只增不删、条目互链的 Living Lab Notebook；通过观察代理行为而非采信其自述来记录日志，且代理无写入该日志的工具。
AI.result: 在 20 个跨学科研究提示、预先固定评分表下，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台；其交付物是唯一记录所运行软件的，且通常附带可重新生成结果的命令；其中一个托管平台使用相同前沿模型但未提供这些内容。
AI.conclusion: 以环境记录与可核查日志为核心的设计能有效提升科研代理的交付质量与可复现性，但当前观察日志尚未捕获软件环境本身，环境记录仍由代理写入而非纳入观察日志；代码以 MIT 许可发布于 https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok。

title: Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation
summary: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的后门移除方法NEEDLE，通过激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间并正交化权重，在保持模型能力与安全性的同时显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后门防御在移除后门时会使模型对良性提示的输出分布发生偏移，导致性能与安全性下降；且通常依赖干净参考模型或原始中毒训练数据，适用性受限。
AI.method: NEEDLE为training-free方法：在识别出触发器后，利用激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间，随后施加顺序权重正交化，抑制后门同时避免改变拒绝相关表示；无需干净参考模型和原始中毒训练数据。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族和攻击类型上评估，NEEDLE在对比防御中取得最低平均攻击成功率（ASR），对挑战性代码注入攻击达到0%，同时KL散度最低，能力与安全性变化最小。
AI.conclusion: NEEDLE能够实现定向后门移除，在不牺牲模型通用能力与安全对齐的前提下有效抑制后门行为，且不依赖干净参考模型或中毒数据。

title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures; code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/tree/main/research/decision-certification
summary: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于信念的智能体记忆决策，证明学习与认证有用决策所需的样本量可远少于校准证据源的样本量，并给出有限样本证书。
AI.motivation: 记忆决策依赖可能噪声、复制或过时的证据，需明确是否必须先校准证据源才能改进决策，并区分学习、校准与修订认证。
AI.method: 在四模型隐马尔可夫族上分析学习未知贝叶斯决策与认证改进的样本复杂度；在未知身份加背景报告信道下刻画策略改进的识别区间，提出基于可观测见证区域的有限样本证书，并扩展至有界历史依赖误设定与条件复制。
AI.result: 学习与认证有用决策比源校准所需样本量可二次方更少；证书在MiniGrid中接受9/9对常量基线的改进和4/9对最后写入胜出的改进，而旧证书无接受；强推理基线仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为记忆决策何时可在不恢复源可靠性的情况下被学习与证明提供了统计解释，并非普遍更优的记忆算法。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 在测试模型与任务中，默认加载完整职业专属系统提示未带来准确率提升，反而显著增加token消耗与成本，甚至降低工具类任务解决率。
AI.motivation: 探究职业专属系统提示（profession-specific system prompts）是否在增加token开销的同时带来一致的准确率收益。
AI.method: 评估开源语料库Scientific Agents（503个职业专属AGENTS.md档案），使用Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter在Pi agent框架中运行。设置四个对照：极简基线、档案开头角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域档案。在9个文本科学基准（4,531题，100个匹配档案）上比较，4,488题完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则评分。另在60个工具使用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上各运行三次。
AI.result: 档案与基线平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无基准显示统计显著提升。匹配档案输出token为1.5-2.3倍，每次成功调用成本为2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench平均解决率：档案46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），因档案下更频繁触发token与时间限制。SuperGPQA上频繁API中断时，短基线首答正确率仅54.0%，档案为71.6%；通用与不匹配提示可靠性相近，说明增益来自提示长度或格式而非领域专长。
AI.conclusion: 对测试模型与任务，默认加载完整职业档案不提升准确率且成本大幅增加；选择性检索档案片段或开放式科学任务是否改变此结论尚待检验。

title: Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LoopGlitch26/Proof-Gated-Signing
summary: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

AI.tldr: 提出Proof-Gated Signing（PGS）以解决智能钱包AI代理预签名检查中的状态漂移问题，通过模拟交易、SMT策略验证及链上后置条件证明，防止有害交易。
AI.motivation: AI代理控制钱包可读取攻击者可触及内容，可能被诱导提出有害交易；现有预签名检查（静态白名单、LLM审查、交易模拟）存在状态漂移缺口，即检查时状态与执行时状态可被对手通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数更改操纵。
AI.method: PGS模拟拟议交易，提取效果，用SMT求解器在预言机不确定带内对每个价格验证声明式价值与权限策略；编译链上后置条件（钱包余额界限、收款人收据、授权上限和所有权），并证明满足后置条件的每次执行也满足策略；智能合约钱包原子强制执行这些条件，保证在任意漂移下执行交易的安全性。
AI.result: 在260个场景（14个攻击家族含5个漂移和2个自适应家族，12个良性家族）的开放测试平台上，以攻击者余额衡量危害，PGS阻止了140个有害场景中的93.6%，通过了97.5%的良性场景；仅模拟检查阻止57.9%，静态白名单阻止71.4%；50个漂移场景中PGS无一产生攻击者收益；唯一未阻止家族（策略内耗尽）由每会话预算限制；给LLM审查者提供干净漂移前模拟会增加其批准漂移攻击的可能性；每次检查开销约41k gas和0.1-0.2秒。
AI.conclusion: PGS能有效抵御状态漂移攻击，显著优于现有检查方法，且开销可接受，但存在策略内耗尽漏洞需预算限制。

title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
summary: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了不同知识追踪（KT）模型下掌握阈值对教学决策的影响，发现阈值需随模型和教学优先级重新校准。
AI.motivation: 掌握阈值用于决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同一数值阈值在不同KT模型下可能导致截然不同的决策，因此需要系统评估其效果。
AI.method: 在四个公开教育数据集上，使用六种KT模型和12个阈值（0.50至0.99），基于进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及先前表现组间差异进行评估，并在30种预设教学情境下寻找平衡阈值。
AI.result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值提高变得更具选择性；最佳平衡阈值因模型和情境而异，半数情境下神经模型与BKT的选定阈值差异超过0.10；更严格的阈值并未可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能限制进阶，强先前表现学生进阶频率最高可达弱先前表现学生的3.26倍。
AI.conclusion: 掌握阈值应随KT模型或教学优先级变化而重新校准，并综合评估其对表现、练习、进阶和公平性的影响。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话幽默中语言模型自动化奖励的奖励漏洞与对策，通过受控测试揭示惊喜奖励和观众模型奖励的缺陷，并评估三种强化学习训练方案。
AI.motivation: 自动化奖励易被模型利用捷径（reward exploits），需设计既能阻断漏洞又能保留目标行为的奖励机制。
AI.method: 采用两种奖励：基于嵌入的惊喜奖励和预测观众娱乐度的观众模型奖励；通过受控测试检验漏洞，并施加流畅性过滤和跨说话人线索归一化等对策；进行三次逐次修订奖励的强化学习训练。
AI.result: 嵌入惊喜奖励接受词序打乱回复，流畅性过滤可检测但误拒机智回复；观众模型易受笑声线索影响，跨说话人归一化可阻断已知攻击但未匹配表达仍可被利用；最终训练提升综合评估0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升未达预注册目标。
AI.conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临普遍挑战：对策必须阻断可利用捷径，同时保留奖励旨在鼓励的行为。

title: On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks
summary: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模型量化如何影响模型反演攻击，并据此提出隐私感知的训练后量化方法，在恢复精度的同时增强反演抵抗力。
AI.motivation: 模型量化降低存储与计算成本，但可能改变模型反演攻击的效果。然而，量化对反演的影响机制及数据特征如何调节这一关系尚不明确，需要从信息论和特征分布角度加以澄清。
AI.method: 通过界定量化引起的输入与预测概率类别变量间互信息变化来区分信息效应与攻击优化障碍；识别数据相关的特征分布与反演结果变化，发现4比特下量化敏感性差异显著。据此提出隐私感知训练后量化方法：使用Fisher型任务敏感度代理进行预算感知比特分配，校准激活范围，联合优化权重与激活尺度及权重量化决策，结合任务恢复与几何保持目标及尺度与量化正则化。
AI.result: 在多种指标、网络架构及人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务上实验：ResNet-50上Palm 4比特将RL-MIA严格成功率从54%降至26%，精度从99.01%降至96.55%（相对FP32）；输出级防御中，Iris 4.5比特加SSD（epsilon=0.1）将BREP-MI严格成功率从63.33%降至37.33%，精度从92.8%降至87.6%（相对仅量化）。
AI.conclusion: 模型量化通过改变互信息和特征分布影响反演攻击效果，且存在数据依赖的4比特敏感差异；所提隐私感知量化方法能有效提升反演抵抗力并恢复效用，同时兼容输出级防御。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
summary: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种保留个体专家区间标签的方法，将标签内不精确性与专家间变异分离，并通过分解预测不确定性来验证其对应关系，在海冰浓度任务上显著降低MAE。
AI.motivation: 机器学习依赖专家标签，但专家间对同一观测可能存在合理分歧，且专家常报告区间而非精确值，导致标签不确定性包含标签内不精确性和专家间变异两个来源。现有方法将二者分开处理：多专家方法坍缩为共识，区间目标方法常输出单点预测，预测不确定性方法很少用观测到的专家分歧验证其不确定性估计。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：1）将异构标签词汇表协调到共同概率标签空间，分离编码差异与专家判断；2）保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，并以适当的Cramér距离目标训练；3）将预测不确定性分解为组件内、组件间和模型不确定性，并评估其是否分别对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性和模型误差，引入分解匹配使预测成分对齐到预期的标签侧来源。
