Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: 提出InFlowOp，用无标签成本指导多智能体工作流的任务分解与智能体分配，并引入Braid基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体工作流构建中，任务分解粒度、智能体选择及新专家创建等决策困难，且改进工作流需参考答案、评分结果或训练评估器，成本高昂。
AI.method: InFlowOp以统一的无标签成本权衡智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度及运行开销；执行前双向确定任务分解粒度和智能体分配，执行中通过同一成本以最低代价纠正故障；同时提出Braid基准，其任务需多智能体协调。
AI.result: 在多个领域和骨干模型上，InFlowOp比单智能体基线最高提升+11.97%，流内优化提升+9.64%。
AI.conclusion: InFlowOp通过无标签成本统一构建与运行时的决策，有效提升多智能体工作流性能，Braid基准为工作流级评估提供支持。

title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了在线批量选择中样本内梯度匹配效果不佳的原因，并提出了无偏的留一法目标LOOM，通过梯度信噪比加权选择样本，在微调任务上超越全批量训练和现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在线批量选择中，匹配候选批次梯度的选择器因无需保留数据而具吸引力，但很少能超越全批量训练，本文旨在解释这一现象并改进。
AI.method: 作者指出样本内梯度匹配因对角线上的协方差惩罚而偏向噪声样本，提出移除对角线得到无偏的留一法目标，其最小化解按梯度信噪比加权样本；据此构建LOOM，在Adam预条件子度量下于反向传播中计算Gram矩阵，贪心选择加权子集（有(1-e^{-γ})保证），无需保留数据。
AI.result: 在四个微调任务和七个1.5B到8B参数的骨干模型上，LOOM在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别比全批量训练提升2.3和2.4个点，比所有样本内梯度匹配器高2.4个点，比验证引导的GREATS和OPUS高1.6-2.0个点，并以低于五分之一的基础率选择注入的标签噪声。
AI.conclusion: LOOM提供了一种高效、无偏的在线批量选择方法，通过梯度信噪比加权，在无需保留数据的情况下显著提升微调性能并增强对标签噪声的鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 提出受控框架ICR，将多智能体通信评估为独立推理后的答案修正，并区分修正与保持行为。
AI.motivation: 现有评估混淆通信效果、智能体架构与额外推理，且最终准确率掩盖了决策如何被通信改变。
AI.method: ICR固定初始推理轨迹，按双方初始正确性条件测量修正与保持，并设置无消息修正对照，在四个推理基准上审计文本与隐式通信及接收者策略。
AI.result: 相似总体准确率可掩盖不同修正行为；完整推理相比仅传答案增加修正但降低保持；结构化验证策略使各通道更倾向保持、减少修正，选择性效果因通道和任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 通信质量并非通道固有属性，ICR将评估重心转向选择性修正，统一分析消息内容与接收者策略如何共同产生收益与危害。

title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
summary: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个可微的标量平衡层来建模向导RNA与RISC池的守恒关系，并利用存档脱靶数据审计剂量和跨上下文实验，但未能确立耦合的额外预测价值。
AI.motivation: 独立的向导-转录本评分未考虑有限的向导负载RISC池的守恒性，需要建立更准确的模型。
AI.method: 构建可微标量平衡层：一个具有唯一正根和精确隐式梯度的守恒方程；推导再分配定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件秩不变性；在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量和跨上下文实验，使用配对置换检验和构建簇自助法。
AI.result: 校正的热力学亲和力与测量的抑制弱相关；耦合未显示额外预测价值，仅GapNet作为描述性指标幸存；剂量拟合异质且常违反模型隐含的指数约束，无法识别竞争参数；可饱和压缩在保留向导家族上保持准确率但未更快。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是可重用的守恒算子和测试所需的实验信息，代码已公开。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“空承诺”概念，即智能体承诺在当前对话轮次之后执行某动作，但其工具或运行环境无法执行该承诺；区别于食言，空承诺仅由智能体配置决定，无需后续轨迹。
AI.motivation: 聊天机器人常做出无法兑现的承诺（如“明天提醒你”），但现有承诺语义未刻画这种由配置导致的空承诺，需要形式化定义与测量方法。
AI.method: 基于承诺语义定义空承诺，提出三种失败类型、可兑现承诺的锚定条件及响应级结果分类；设计测量协议，在五种逐步增加持久化能力的设置下进行后续请求，环境隐式或显式。
AI.result: 给出了空承诺的形式化定义、失败类型、锚定条件和结果分类，并建立了可操作的五种设置测量协议。
AI.conclusion: 空承诺可由智能体配置独立判定，所提定义与协议为评估和诊断此类承诺提供了系统框架。

title: Exact information accounting for SGD methods
summary: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论角度对随机梯度下降及其变体进行精确分析，指出预条件SGD步是高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，其单步遗憾可分解为内在时间代价与比较器信息变化。
AI.motivation: 作为标准几何分析的替代，旨在从信息论视角统一解释SGD及其多种变体的行为与收敛性质。
AI.method: 将预条件SGD步建模为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，推导单步遗憾分解，并将该分解扩展为目标函数的恒等式，在合成与真实训练中测量各项。
AI.result: 凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化的联系、学习率调度、自适应优化器以及噪声、动量、重尾、无梯度等SGD变体均对应恒等式中的某一项或特例；真实网络实验中，该分解解释了经典收敛界松弛的来源，并按步数数量与一致性区分达到相同训练损失的优化器，但其与泛化优劣的关系因网络而异。
AI.conclusion: 该信息论恒等式为SGD及其变体提供统一分析框架；但基于锐度的泛化认证在数据无关各向同性先验下，除非曲率谱在所有参数上近乎平坦，否则在网络规模下是空洞的。

title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
summary: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出动作条件网络世界模型，学习网络扩散动力学并预测干预结果，作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，实现高效动作选择算法。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统中的动作效果具有延迟性，现有方法依赖蒙特卡洛模拟评估候选动作，在大量采样轨迹下计算成本成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建动作条件网络世界模型，学习网络在时间干预下的扩散动力学，对网络施加动作并预测后续结果；将其作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，由编码智能体利用完整 rollout、动作级信用分配和反事实探测反馈来设计与改进可执行算法。
AI.result: 在八个网络任务和五种扩散模型上，所设计算法在141个设置中的138个达到或超过最强已报告基线，且 rollout 速度相比蒙特卡洛模拟最高提升14.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的网络世界模型可替代昂贵的模拟评估，支撑高效迭代的算法设计，在多数网络干预任务上取得领先性能并显著加速。

title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
summary: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

AI.tldr: 提出VANE，将MoE-LoRA的路由从“对token打分”改为“对更新打分”，通过reader-writer分解与低秩罗盘高效评估所有专家对的更新有用性。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE-LoRA方法存在两个缺陷：一是每个专家将输入侧因子与输出侧因子绑定，二是路由器仅对token打分，无法看到专家实际会写出什么更新，因此无法准确评估专家的真实有用性。
AI.method: 基于一阶分析，将专家更新与负损失梯度的内积作为有用性度量；把每个专家拆分为reader（下投影）和writer（上投影），使所有N_A×N_B对的有用性在共享秩r空间中变为内积，从而用N_A+N_B个向量为所有对打分。VANE用低秩罗盘预测每个token的下降方向，按更新与罗盘的对齐度评分所有对而不实际构造更新，用加性门激活top-k对，并为每对提供精确的一阶路由梯度。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上的单域常识推理与四域多任务混合实验中，VANE在十二种PEFT和MoE-LoRA基线中取得最佳平均性能，分别提升0.9–1.1和1.3–1.5个点，且可训练参数不到8专家MoE-LoRA的一半；其路由分数与专家实测有用性的吻合度远高于token路由器。
AI.conclusion: 路由应评估更新而非token；reader-writer分解使更新评估可高效并行计算，VANE在性能、参数效率与路由准确性上均优于现有方法。

title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

AI.tldr: 提出APIVIS训练框架，将有限预算Gumbel搜索适配到块级数学推理中，通过混合直接与搜索响应并选择性监督搜索改进的token，提升RLVR的数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽提升大模型数学推理，但现有引入搜索以增加轨迹多样性的方法无法保证搜索诱导的rollout策略优于当前策略；需解决搜索带来的改进能否转化为有效策略提升的问题。
AI.method: APIVIS在每次rollout组内混合直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索发现的改进产生有信息量的相对奖励；对搜索改进的token施加选择性监督，避免均匀组奖励导致GRPO失效；采用有限预算Gumbel搜索进行块级数学推理，并给出精确值引导选择提升期望验证器奖励的理论保证，以及在值估计误差有界下的近似保证。
AI.result: 在公认数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，APIVIS相较竞争性搜索方法取得显著提升，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: APIVIS通过混合搜索与直接响应并选择性监督，确保搜索改进转化为策略改进，为RLVR数学推理提供有效训练框架。

title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
summary: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF），一种连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归模型的噪声-数据耦合实现少步高质量文本生成。
AI.motivation: 现有少步语言生成方法在采样质量和效率上存在不足，需要借助预训练自回归模型的结构先验来改进连续流模型的路径构造与采样。
AI.method: 理论上证明由自回归模型诱导的Gumbel噪声与one-hot token序列之间的耦合产生非相交线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，其中切向（速度）条件直接由AR教师模型引导，以增强少步路径采样质量。
AI.result: 在预训练及下游任务等多个基准上，GSF均优于当前少步语言生成基线。
AI.conclusion: GSF通过显式利用AR模型的噪声-数据耦合与教师引导的流映射目标，有效提升了少步语言生成的质量与效率，为连续流语言模型提供了新思路。

title: YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents
comment: Accepted to the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference. 21 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
summary: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

AI.tldr: YouRA 是一种有状态、证据可追溯的自主研究智能体架构，通过跟踪研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，缓解论文主张与实验不符的结构性问题。
AI.motivation: 端到端研究智能体可生成完整论文，但主张常与实验脱节，根因在于研究状态、失败历史和主张-证据对齐未作为持久可验证状态在长流程中维护。
AI.method: 提出 YouRA，集成三部分：验证状态架构（VSA）跟踪假设、门控与证据指针；独立控制器将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复和辩论/评审控制，并分离控制与执行；有状态反思将失败记录为结构化经验，并通过有界修复、重设计或重置引导恢复。
AI.result: 在 MLR-Bench 预定义十任务端到端子集上，YouRA 在三个匹配骨干网络中整体得分均优于 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2；基于幻觉分类的诊断给出四类事实性失败的交集/并集计数，数据来源诊断显示更多真实数据输出；消融 VSA、独立控制器、MCP 工具访问和反思引导恢复均支持各自独立贡献，移除任一核心状态组件均使性能低于完整系统。
AI.conclusion: 持久可验证的研究状态与证据追踪是提升自主研究可靠性的关键；YouRA 的状态化架构及其组件可分离地改善端到端表现，并减少事实性与数据来源问题。

title: Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving
summary: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）服务中请求成本估计不准的问题，提出保留块-步二维结构的去噪工作负载曲面（DWS）及轻量预测器。
AI.motivation: 现有成本代理指标（输出长度、去噪步数）将dLLM的二维执行结构压缩为标量，忽略了单次前向可解掩多个token及每步成本异构性，导致调度与资源分配不准。
AI.method: 定义DWS：以输出块和块内去噪步的二维概率曲面加权异构每步成本；设计由粗到细训练方案，使仅需提示的轻量预测器准确预测DWS，可在单CPU核运行，且因解耦请求执行行为与部署成本因素而跨硬件迁移无需重训。
AI.result: 真实服务实验中，DWS将成本预测误差较标量预测器最多降低2.50倍；DWS引导的最短作业优先调度器将在线聊天机器人端到端延迟最多降低1.92倍。
AI.conclusion: 保留dLLM二维执行结构的DWS能显著提升成本预测精度和调度效率，并具备跨硬件泛化能力。

title: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
summary:
As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自动文献综述发现NeurIPS 2025的5285篇论文几乎未报告环境影响，为此提出标准化可持续性指标、推理碳成本估算启发式方法及carbonbenchmark工具，并形式化SMAJ框架以推动AI领域关注计算效率和环境责任。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型能力增强和普及，其环境足迹日益扩大；尽管有负责任AI的呼吁，机器学习社区仍缺乏标准化的碳核算实践，且现有研究过度追求边际精度提升而忽视环境成本。
AI.method: 对NeurIPS 2025接受的5285篇论文进行自动文献综述；定义评估模型训练效率的标准化可持续性指标，并提供简单启发式方法估算LLM推理的碳成本；在carbonbenchmark软件解决方案中实现这些指标；形式化“Smallest Model that Achieves the Job”（SMAJ）框架。
AI.result: 自动文献综述显示，NeurIPS 2025论文中环境影响报告几乎不存在；提出的标准化指标和carbonbenchmark工具可用于跟踪和报告排放；SMAJ框架被形式化以挑战传统SotA精度优先的范式。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习社区需转向可持续AI，采用标准化碳核算和SMAJ框架，在追求精度的同时优先考虑计算效率与环境责任。

title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action
summary: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出TDAction训练动态动作准则，根据共享参数实现成本选择传输目标，在ImageNet上实现FID低于1.1的单步生成。
AI.motivation: 现有传输目标主要评估分布运动，但神经生成器需通过共享参数更新联合实现样本位移，训练时需权衡'下一步分布移动'与'有限生成器学习最终映射的路径'。
AI.method: 将成本建模为软终端控制问题，推导闭式Batch Tangent Action-to-Go值，考虑参数努力与终端不匹配；随机切向探针提供低秩实现，构造共享分离目标而不增加推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，TDAction无需蒸馏达到FID低于1.1；受控实验揭示了生成器几何、传输选择与局部动作实现的关系。
AI.conclusion: TDAction通过考虑共享参数实现成本与跨样本交互，有效指导一步生成模型训练，实现高质量单步生成。

title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
summary: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体框架AbsorbEvo，将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收器逆向设计，显著提升设计成功率与覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 高性能微波吸收器设计需电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程等多领域专业知识，且优化过程耗时；现有通用智能体与随机搜索效率低。
AI.method: AbsorbEvo采用候选进化策略，融合语言推理、物理预测与历史反馈；大语言模型基于任务目标与计算历史提出参数调整方向与幅度，结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选，用低成本预测模型作为物理先验排序，仅对高排名设计进行全波仿真，通过物理有效性检查的结果用于评估性能并指导搜索；训练任务经验蒸馏为文本技能，经独立验证后用于新任务。
AI.result: 在留出的AbsorbBench-36任务上，相同提案预算下，AbsorbEvo任务成功率达79.17%，通用智能体为25.00%，随机搜索为12.50%；平均最佳覆盖度为0.7816，后两者分别为0.6434与0.6448。
AI.conclusion: AbsorbEvo将语言推理与物理反馈融入设计决策，为自然语言驱动的微波吸收器自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

title: SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions
comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/liangyou03/SimplexUQ and https://huggingface.co/datasets/liangyou03/SimplexTasks-12-data
summary: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

AI.tldr: SimplexUQ 是首个针对单纯形值预测的 conformal 校准覆盖分配问题的基准与可复现协议，它比较现有 conformal 包装器而非提出新方法。
AI.motivation: 单个校准阈值虽能保证边际覆盖，但会导致覆盖分布不均，易区域过度覆盖、难区域覆盖不足，需系统测量该分配问题。
AI.method: 构建任务套件 SimplexTasks-12（6 个受控合成机制 + 6 个冻结预测器的真实任务），固定预测器、评分和分层映射，仅变化包装器，报告边际覆盖、最差层覆盖、最大差异及任务内半径与计算量。
AI.result: 全局校准可能看似有效实则失败：CIFAR-10 上边际覆盖 0.900 但最差熵层仅 0.542，Mondrian 校准将该层提升至 0.886 并将最大差异从 0.358 降至 0.022；无包装器占优，Mondrian 在 12 个任务的目标分区上差异更低，BatchMVP 在 5 个任务的交叠组上差异更低。
AI.conclusion: 包装器选择应视为诊断比较而非通用排名，去除预测器偏差仅部分减少全局阈值差异，并发布任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组及重建说明。

title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量适配器CortexBridge，将任意EEG导联布局映射到共享皮层潜在空间，提升多个基础模型的BCI分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型通常使用固定通道词汇或有限导联集进行预训练，当电极布局变化时迁移困难。
AI.method: CortexBridge结合EEG特征与电极及图谱坐标，将任意导联布局映射到共享皮层潜在空间；在MOABB的五个BCI数据集上，用三个冻结的基础模型进行评估。
AI.result: 在15次评估中的13次提升性能；平衡准确率平均提升：EEGPT为0.80%，LaBraM为0.70%，CBraMod为3.26%，12类SSVEP分类最大提升13.02%；学习到的图谱表示显示任务依赖空间模式，SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络中的表示比听觉P300更集中。
AI.conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为一种可学习且解剖学上合理的路由机制，将异构EEG导联布局适配到预训练基础模型。

title: Random Recursive Models
summary: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出随机递归模型（RRM），通过从L层池中随机采样层进行T步递归，实现参数高效且灵活的深度计算。
AI.motivation: 现有递归模型通常重复使用单一变换或固定变换序列，限制了计算深度和层顺序的灵活性。
AI.method: 维护L个可学习层的池，每个样本每一步独立有放回地采样一层，执行T步递归计算。
AI.result: 在推理任务上匹配或超越基线，参数减少50-75%；支持推理时变深度、蒙特卡洛推理和概率测试时缩放，均提升性能且无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: RRM为神经网络架构设计提供了新方向，兼顾参数效率与计算灵活性。

title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
summary:
Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究将指令微调的语言模型置于六个基于Snowdrop的DSGE模拟器中，通过比较PPO与GRPO在长视野信用分配问题上的表现，评估政策行动是否与模拟经济动态一致。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成看似合理的经济政策回应，但这并不证明其行动符合经济动态。现有评估仅依赖语言合理性，缺乏对行动经济后果的模拟验证。
AI.method: 构建通用Python接口支持重复rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆和滚动视野模拟；在六个DSGE模拟器中，模型每轮观察经济状态和话语变化，选择有界政策行动，获得下一状态和经济奖励。以PPO为主要方法（利用学习价值函数和广义优势估计传播延迟奖励），GRPO为匹配的无批评家基线（使用组相对优势，无法区分早期轮次）。实验还测试方向性语义信号、奖励视野、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。
AI.result: GRPO因无学习价值函数，在长视野信用分配中无法区分导致结果的早期轮次；若所有rollout获得相同回报，归一化优势为零。PPO则可通过价值函数和GAE将延迟奖励传播到早期token。
AI.conclusion: 应通过模拟经济后果而非仅凭语言合理性来评判政策行动，PPO在长视野信用分配任务中优于GRPO。

title: Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization
summary: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究紧凸下闭集上非负非单调DR-子模函数的对抗在线最大化问题，证明了一个新的比较器一致一阶不等式，将在线系数从0.401提升至4/9，并给出了参数化上下界及匹配结果。
AI.motivation: 现有在线DR-子模最大化的最优系数仅为0.401，且在一般凸集上缺乏紧致的上下界刻画，尤其是当集合包含ζ1时系数如何变化尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过有序坐标论证构造目标无关的有理动作，证明比较器一致的一阶不等式；利用三组对称间隙构造离线预言机上界，并给出参数化扩展与精确有限实例界。
AI.result: 在线系数提升至4/9（每轮一次梯度查询和一次投影，O(√T)期望近似遗憾）；当ζ1∈K时系数改进为α̲(ζ)=1/2-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]；离线预言机上界β_*=0.470438…（ζ=0），上下界在ζ≥1/2时于1/2处匹配，最优亏损为Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著改进了在线DR-子模最大化的理论保证，刻画了ζ参数下的最优系数，并给出了自适应对抗和价值反馈下的遗憾界，包括每轮一次噪声值反馈的O(T^{3/4})遗憾。

title: Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay
summary: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM智能体环境中并发动作的仲裁问题，通过类型化快照结算合约审计顺序敏感性、有效进展和重放一致性三项属性。
AI.motivation: 即使每个提案单独有效，并发动作仍需仲裁，需验证结算策略在顺序、进展和重放方面的表现。
AI.method: 实现类型化快照结算合约，测试五种结算策略，进行28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160次脚本化多步情节，并单独审计全状态日志（156个检查点和1,332个构造损坏）。
AI.result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变；保守拒绝在六智能体门任务中仅完成31.25%，而随机票完成90.28%，配对改进59.03个百分点（95%自助区间50.00-68.06）；所有策略保持空间约束，优先级仲裁仍错过独立小实例最优；日志审计精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个构造损坏，保留终端锚点。
AI.conclusion: 证据涉及执行语义，而非人类现实性或长期公平性。

title: Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics
summary: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估混合量子-经典机器学习在时空脑变形场降阶预测中的表现，发现经典网络在精度与稳定性上优于量子变体。
AI.motivation: 高维位移场计算不可行，需降阶预测，并检验近期量子机器学习在物理场学习中的潜力。
AI.method: 采用本征正交分解（POD）将数据投影至低维潜空间，设计静态时序到潜变量回归与自回归潜状态预测两类任务，系统对比紧凑经典基线、最小及增强混合量子架构（VQC、QLSTM）。
AI.result: 静态回归中经典POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，增强VQC显著优于最小VQC；时序预测中经典POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口和随机初始化下均比增强QLSTM精度更高、统计更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 降阶物理场学习可作为近期量子机器学习的严格测试平台；混合增强能恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在保真度和稳定性上仍具决定性优势。

title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
summary: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练推理过程ReSolve，通过选择性生成式调节复用候选推理，在竞赛数学题上以更少token达到更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 多解采样会将计算浪费在中间推导和未完成论证上，而非仅用于最终答案，因此希望复用候选推理中的计算。
AI.method: ReSolve采用答案分布控制器，在候选答案不一致或无法解析时调用模型检查已有推导，并将生成解纳入有界循环；使用Hybrid评分，在130道竞赛数学题、两个独立候选池上评估。
AI.result: ReSolve分别获得100和99个正确答案，优于同四候选投票的91和92，且无正确变错误；八样本自一致性为94和96但token消耗显著更高，ReSolve分别少用46.3%和47.2% token；消融去除可见推导后准确率从100降至93；选择性Uniform调节与始终开启均解97题，但选择性减少约54%调节token和6.2%总流程token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将候选推理作为可复用推理计算；但未证明相对额外采样有准确率优势，也未证明专门路由指令有独特收益。

title: Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization
summary: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DS-MoE框架，通过差次模优化重新定义MoE专家选择，显式建模专家间的冗余与协同，并设计MM算法求解，实验优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: MoE模型因稀疏激活可扩展容量，但部署受内存限制；提取紧凑专家子集是可行方案，然而现有Top-k启发式独立评估单个专家，忽略了门控网络引入的专家间依赖关系。
AI.method: 分析损失退化的二阶泰勒展开，揭示专家组合中的功能对偶性：冗余（表示重叠）与协同（互补误差抵消）；将选择目标建模为差次模函数，以解耦冗余削减与协同最大化；设计具有单调性保证的majorization-minimization算法高效求解最优专家子集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DS-MoE能有效保留不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: DS-MoE为MoE专家选择提供了理论严谨的框架，显式处理专家间依赖，在保持性能的同时降低内存需求。

title: When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design
comment: Exploratory offline audit of subject-disjoint skeleton-based exercise correctness evaluation; 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

AI.tldr: 该审计通过分离评估聚合、子集结构和时序表示，检验了关节选择对基于骨架的动作正确性分类的增益是否稳健。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明运动特异性关节选择可提升基于骨架的正确性分类，但该增益的统计与结构稳健性不明确，需要通过明确的估计量和合适的对照来审计。
AI.method: 对REHAB24-6十名受试者的1,057次重复进行审计，区分合并折外AUROC与等权个体内AUROC两种聚合方式，并比较手动子集kNN与1,000个维度匹配随机映射；同时匹配双侧结构和躯干包含性，比较RBF-SVM、逻辑回归和随机卷积对照，并加入序列顺序与配对种子控制。
AI.result: 手动子集kNN增益从合并折外AUROC的0.055降至等权个体内AUROC的0.020，两者配对区间均包含零；在1,000个随机映射中，14个达到或超过手动合并结果，匹配双侧结构和躯干包含后为145个；RBF-SVM在个体内估计量下保持正增益，而逻辑回归和随机卷积对照点增益为负。
AI.conclusion: 该探索性审计表明关节选择主张需要明确估计量和结构适当的对照，并未建立新算法或临床获益。

title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
summary: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 本文初步研究了替代传统神经网络层中仿射变换的Soft Dominance Layer，通过可学习的参考向量和sigmoid松弛实现可微的阈值比较，并在MNIST上进行了单次运行实验。
AI.motivation: 探索一种具有直接阈值解释且可训练的神经网络基本单元，作为仿射层的潜在替代方案，但并非声称要取代仿射层。
AI.method: 提出Soft Dominance Layer：每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习的参考向量比较，聚合平滑的不等式响应；使用sigmoid松弛使比较可微，并通过锐度参数α控制向硬阈值决策的过渡。在MNIST上进行单次运行实验，对比MLP基线，并测试退火效果。
AI.result: Soft Dominance最高准确率为0.9061（无退火）和0.9173（有退火），MLP基线为0.9827。学习到的参考向量表现出空间结构，提供结构化学习的定性证据。描述性结果未建立可靠的配置排序或统计支持的退火收益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究作为概念验证，表明Soft Dominance Layer具有可训练性和阈值可解释性，但需要重复种子实验和更广泛数据集来评估鲁棒性和实际相关性。

title: Federated Agent Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联邦智能体优化（FAO）这一新问题，研究分布式LLM智能体如何在隐私与专有限制下，通过受控信息交换协作提升能力，而非共享原始数据、完整轨迹或私有知识。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在私有环境中积累经验，但受隐私和专有限制无法直接共享；传统联邦学习仅针对模型参数，无法覆盖智能体在记忆、工具、奖励、技能和结构化知识等方面的能力。
AI.method: 将FAO形式化为平衡智能体效用、隐私泄漏和通信成本的多目标问题，从策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励、结构化知识与技能等维度组织优化空间，并刻画私有经验如何被抽象、保护、聚合和适应为可迁移能力。
AI.result: 给出了智能体在不直接共享经验情况下相互受益的统一视角，并识别了FAO的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: FAO为构建可信联邦智能体系统提供了新方向，并概述了若干未来研究方向。

title: Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究概率测度上的算子学习，针对重尾测度下softmax注意力积分发散问题，提出使用增长更慢的注意力核，并构建基准进行验证。
AI.motivation: softmax中的指数加权在多项式尾测度下会导致测度级注意力积分发散，因此需要采用增长更慢的函数替代指数函数。
AI.method: 构建两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准；研究后归一化Transformer中注意力核增长与数据变换；比较softmax与三种慢增长核，并测试Symlog预处理；在矩阵求逆、剪切交换任务及高斯控制上评估；分析样本量对经验能量和Wasserstein距离尾部差异敏感性的影响。
AI.result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上出现集成崩溃，而三种慢增长核避免崩溃；Symlog预处理使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免崩溃，但在剪切交换任务上仍崩溃；高斯控制下四种核表现相似；样本量影响经验能量和Wasserstein距离对尾部差异的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 慢增长注意力核是后归一化Transformer从重尾集成中学习的有效设计选择。

title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

AI.tldr: 提出依赖感知奖励塑造（DARS），通过谓词依赖图分配步骤级信用，改善强化学习训练大语言模型的终端奖励稀疏问题。
AI.motivation: 终端奖励仅提供成功/失败信号，无法区分步骤重要性，且未考虑错误步骤的后续无效性。
AI.method: 将任务进度表示为带前置关系的谓词，标注器标记每步验证、无效或修复的谓词；根据到最近破坏前提的图距离折扣验证谓词，独立谓词不受影响；修复更新权重，无效谓词需重新验证；固定势函数转换为带符号的每步奖励；通用接口可集成现有方法。
AI.result: 在五个任务族和1.5B-8B模型上，DARS在ALFWorld上比GiGPO提升最多10个点，提高WebShop任务分数和Search-R1 QA准确率，补充AEPO在AIME24/25上的训练，在1.7B和4B模型上超越OmniOPD；消融实验证明步骤级信用、依赖衰减和图拓扑各自有效；8B蒸馏标注器匹配API标注器。
AI.conclusion: DARS有效利用依赖图提供步骤级信用，提升多种推理和智能体训练方法的性能，且可高效运行无需前沿评判器。

title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现多奖励强化学习中存在批次级信号不平衡，并提出密度感知奖励聚合方法DARA来校正奖励权重，从而加速多目标行为学习。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习需同时满足多个行为目标，但不同目标的学习进度不均，即使采用GDPO中的奖励归一化，仍存在残余的批次级信号不平衡，需要一种能自适应校准奖励贡献的方法。
AI.method: 通过定义优势能量（一个奖励在批次上平方优势之和），在理想化GDPO归一化下证明其与活跃组密度成正比。基于此提出DARA，采用逆平方根密度校正，根据每个rollout批次动态计算权重，对不常活跃的奖励信号赋予更大权重，且不改变底层策略优化目标。
AI.result: 在工具调用和数学推理任务上，DARA比GDPO更快学习目标行为：工具调用中格式合规达到高水平的训练步数最多减少26%，数学推理中长度合规接近饱和的步数最多减少65%，最终性能仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DARA通过密度感知的奖励聚合有效缓解了多奖励学习中的信号不平衡，加速了多目标行为的学习，同时保持最终性能，代码已开源。

title: Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models
summary: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过迭代囚徒困境实验，考察前沿生成式AI模型的合作倾向及声誉、策略和非言语情绪信号对其的影响，并对比非推理模型与推理模型的差异。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在经济和社会重要互动中承担日益自主的角色，理解其合作倾向及影响因素对负责任部署至关重要。
AI.method: 采用迭代囚徒困境范式，操纵对手声誉（积极、未知、消极）、策略（勒索 vs. 慷慨）和非言语情绪信号（面部表情传递竞争或合作评价）。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），并引入诊断性和谐博弈。
AI.result: 非推理模型中，合作受三因素系统性影响，类似人类行为模式，但模型间权重差异大。推理模型更集中依赖策略和声誉，非推理模型中的波将金效应近乎消失，情绪作用更具条件性，符合层级线索加权策略。推理模型终局行为异质，从持续合作到系统性最后一轮背叛，揭示模型特定的可剥削性特征。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI模型正成为日益复杂但异质的社会行为者，开发标准化合作基准对指导其在互动性、社会重要场景中的负责任部署具有实际价值。

title: From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts
summary: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习中客户端内部任务混合的复合异构性，提出FedSEE方法通过输入路由到专门专家来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习未解决客户端内部潜在任务混合问题，导致负迁移，需处理同时跨客户端和客户端内的异构性。
AI.method: 基于公共冻结表示，利用平方损失下任务混合最优模型为底层任务最优模型的凸组合，推导凸规划恢复任务专家并对齐，提出FedSEE实现输入依赖的专家选择路由。
AI.result: 实验中FedSEE避免基线负迁移，整体性能提升2.9分，最差服务四分之一客户端提升3.7分。
AI.conclusion: 有效专业化需要与客户端任务混合对齐的输入依赖专家选择，FedSEE能有效处理复合异构性。

title: HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

AI.tldr: 提出分层哈希检索（HHR），通过几何感知路由和学习哈希投影，解决哈希检索中汉明距离与注意力相关性不匹配的问题，提升长上下文推理效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于哈希的检索方法虽高效，但二值化丢弃了特征幅度信息，导致汉明距离与Query-Key对数几率不匹配，产生低对数几率键的假阳性检索和高对数几率键的假阴性遗漏。
AI.method: HHR采用由粗到细框架：几何感知键路由（GKR）学习头级正交变换，重新分配特征幅度并推导更具判别性的页级对数几率边界，以剪枝低对数几率键；学习哈希投影（LHP）学习头级投影空间，使汉明距离与真实Query-Key相关性排序对齐，实现细粒度检索。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和基准上，HHR优于现有方法。例如在LongBench上平均分提升1.10分；在128K上下文长度下，对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现高达3.30倍解码加速和2.83倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: HHR通过结合GKR和LHP，有效抑制假阳性并恢复假阴性，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力的保真度，实现高效准确的长上下文推理。

title: Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Global South in AI
summary: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出激活内存而非计算量是CNN在微控制器上推理的瓶颈，纠正了已有原位卷积内存最优公式的两类错误，并提出Right In-Place (RiP)卷积，在保持逐位一致和行主序访问的前提下显著降低峰值激活内存。
AI.motivation: 直接原位卷积可消除双缓冲开销，但Gural与Murmann的内存最优公式仅适用于valid padding、单位步长、单位膨胀和奇数方核，且需非顺序遍历导致2倍推理时间；其闭式解在两类情况下失效，存在静默输入损坏和上至2432倍的高估问题。
AI.method: 识别并修正原文闭式解的两类失效情形：(1)少分配(k-1)C_in mod (C_out-C_in)个标量导致仍存活输入的静默损坏；(2)当关键支路离开输出网格时产生无界高估。将其推广到任意步长、膨胀、padding和矩形核，并提出RiP卷积：每层在共享工作区右对齐读取输入、从索引零左对齐写出输出；由于偏移量关于输出像素索引分段仿射，可在O(1)内求断点得到最小安全间隔，同时保持行主序访问。
AI.result: 在10000个随机层上RiP无损坏；在来自25种架构的84个卷积层中，58个与herringbone工作区完全一致，81个在5%以内，平均比双缓冲节省24.8%内存。写入TinyEngine内核并部署到Raspberry Pi Pico 1和Pico 2后，在十一个MCUNet模型上峰值激活内存降低12.5%至33.3%，周期数不变且输出逐位一致，使适合Pico 1 256 KB SRAM的模型数从六个增至九个。
AI.conclusion: RiP卷积通过纠正已有内存最优公式的错误并泛化到任意卷积配置，在不增加推理时间和不改变数值结果的情况下有效降低峰值激活内存，提升受限硬件上CNN模型的部署能力。

title: Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget
summary: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

AI.tldr: 该工作将小模型与大模型（黑盒API）的协作重新定义为在API预算约束下的信息获取问题，由小模型主导推理，仅在需要时向大模型提出针对性查询，并用三阶段RLVR框架学习何时调用、如何提问与如何整合信息。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作多被视为计算分配问题，决定哪部分推理交给哪个模型；但在黑盒API场景下，这种粗粒度委派和跨模型切换时反复传输上下文导致效率低下。
AI.method: 提出三阶段RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）框架，联合优化顾问调用与信息使用：学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有用查询、以及如何将协作信息融入推理过程；SLM保持为主推理器，仅在需要时选择性查询黑盒LLM顾问。
AI.result: 在数学推理和编程任务上，该方法相比现有协作基线改善了性能-成本权衡，在某些设置下达到或超过问题级最优路由（oracle problem-level routing）的效果；策略还能无需额外训练迁移到其他顾问模型系列。
AI.conclusion: 将SLM-LLM协作建模为预算约束下的信息获取问题，并通过RLVR学习调用与查询策略，可在黑盒API环境下实现更优的性能-成本权衡，并具备跨顾问模型的迁移能力。

title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

AI.tldr: 该论文将部分可观测强化学习中的记忆需求形式化为保持、重写和经验融合三类，并提出ALER代理与Rune-Mazes基准。
AI.motivation: 现有RL记忆架构与基准多测试信息保持能力，而后续观测可能使存储信息过时或改变其决策含义，因此需要显式处理重写和经验融合。
AI.method: 提出ALER，结合LSTM与槽记忆，使用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入将权重集中于一个槽以覆写，并学习门控在策略和价值头前融合检索内容与循环状态；同时构建Rune-Mazes，包含在向量和像素观测下反转、取消、重置或重复隐藏线索更新的三个环境。
AI.result: 在十六个Endless T-Maze配置中ALER成功率至少0.82，在五个Rune T-Maze组合中至少0.99，在带Invert符文的四分支Rune Multi-Corridor上平均成功率最高；在像素Rune MiniGrid Memory的十个配置中有八个平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。
AI.conclusion: ALER通过显式重写与融合机制有效满足RL中超越保持的记忆需求，并在多类需要更多记忆状态的任务上优于多个基线。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 论文研究动态任务路由：事件流会改写任务绑定，系统需在每个查询时刻先选出有效文档版本再作答。作者将六个基准改造成31,119个动态片段、373,428个按时间分类的查询，并提出RIAG多智能体策略，在极少调用下取得更高联合路由与答题准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议给定固定、预选任务，无法检验智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响的工作、或重建历史任务绑定，因此需要研究任务绑定被事件动态修订的场景。
AI.method: 将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval六个基准重铸为动态片段与按时间分类的查询；提出Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG），把确定性时间解析与任务推理解耦，按不可变文档身份缓存解答，每个新任务先给两次未暴露尝试，并按条件触发审计与修复，每个文档版本至多四次调用。
AI.result: 同构RIAG在该集合上以0.62次调用/查询达到54.24%的联合路由与答题准确率；最强对比方法为18.00次调用/查询、32.22%。异构RIAG以0.63次调用/查询达到49.78%。
AI.conclusion: 该设定揭示了核心权衡：每个事件后重算会浪费工作，而无保护地复用会返回过期结论；RIAG通过有界多智能体策略与按文档身份缓存、条件审计修复，在显著降低调用量的同时提升联合路由与答题准确率。

title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出MIKASA-Robo-VLA基准，包含90个语言条件操作任务，其中80个隐藏关键线索以评估VLA策略的记忆能力，并发布大量演示轨迹及基线结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略通常仅依赖近期少数帧，难以评估其在任务中利用已消失信息的能力。
AI.method: 构建90个任务，其中80个隐藏动作所依赖的线索，10个为反应式控制；为70个任务指定环境阶段时序以定义信息缺口，并发布22,500条覆盖10种记忆类型的轨迹；微调无历史或显式记忆模块的π_{0.5}基线。
AI.result: 在14个微调任务上，π_{0.5}基线平均成功率为0.211 ± 0.044；在Long-split任务上成功率更低，受开环分块及该子集记忆类型混淆。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为评估VLA策略的长期记忆能力提供了标准化平台，并揭示了现有无记忆模型在记忆依赖任务上的显著不足。

title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
comment: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
summary: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DeFA框架，通过依赖图实现LLM智能体执行中的决定性错误定位与失败归因。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体执行中错误与可见后果常相隔多步，需同时理解步骤内容与依赖关系才能定位决定性错误。
AI.method: DeFA先结合协议关系与语义依赖构建事件依赖图；再识别可能违反任务要求的事件，追踪来源与后续影响，构建失败传播图；最后利用步骤证据及在传播中的角色定位决定性错误、责任智能体和错误类别。为处理长轨迹，将执行分段，用当前段详细内容与其他段摘要结合，实现局部诊断并获取全局上下文。
AI.result: 在Who and When及Who and When Pro文本子集上，所有评估骨干模型均取得最高责任智能体与精确步骤准确率；在Pro上分类对齐方法中失败模式准确率最高。图像与视频轨迹实验证明其多模态失败归因适用性。消融实验支持分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图的贡献。将DeFA诊断反馈用于Trace2Skill技能进化，下游任务准确率较原生流程提升6-15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DeFA能有效定位智能体决定性错误并支持后续任务改进。

title: Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions
summary:
One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

AI.tldr: 深度线性残差网络学习恒等映射时，尽管沿残差连接已有恒等路径，SGD仍偏好特定权重分解而非零权重解，熵损失理论可解释此现象。
AI.motivation: 探究SGD在恒等映射学习任务中为何偏好特定解而非零权重解，并理解参数化对学习行为的影响。
AI.method: 通过理论分析熵损失（在种群损失上加入与微批量梯度平方范数期望成正比的项）在恒等流形上的极小值，推导SGD偏好解的结构预测，并与实验对比。
