AI.result: 在异向标签噪声下，学习到的层呈现噪声相关谱；权重衰减不能恢复零权重解；将权重矩阵分解为两个矩阵乘积可导致权重坍缩为零；SGD训练结果与熵损失预测高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 恒等学习任务表明，熵损失视角能清晰解释SGD为何偏好同一输入输出函数的不同分解方式。

title: Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class
summary: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在自定步调练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分移至对解答的事前验证，以解决反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力。
AI.motivation: 大型电气工程课程中学生与助教比例高，学习者遇到问题可能等待数天才能获得反馈，而生成式AI虽能扩展对话式反馈，但用于评估作业会引发信任与问责问题，人工介入又会重新引入延迟。
AI.method: 设计并试点一个生成式AI练习平台，在自定步调练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分转移到对解答的前期验证。
AI.result: 研究旨在了解学生如何参与该工具、如何感知其反馈的价值与可靠性，以及哪些经验可迁移至其他工程学科。
AI.conclusion: 该平台有望在实践中化解反馈即时性与人工监督可信度之间的张力，并为其他工程学科提供可借鉴的经验。

title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
summary: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模式连通性和低损失区域几何的分析框架，预测并观察到反突然泛化案例，表明突然泛化源于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域错位。
AI.motivation: 突然泛化（grokking）的底层机制尚未确定，现有相关性解释存在不足，需要更本质的几何分析框架。
AI.method: 构建基于模式连通性和低损失区域几何的分析框架；在标准模算术任务上使用保持对称性的训练/验证划分进行实验。
AI.result: 在保持对称性的划分下观察到稳定的反突然泛化案例：验证性能不再恢复；该反例挑战了多种现有相关性解释。
AI.conclusion: 突然泛化发生在训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域错位时；当这些区域良好对齐后，仅靠训练超参数无法产生突然泛化，动力学坍缩为可训练或不可训练行为。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE-AD，一种面向阿尔茨海默病诊断的成本感知序数信念规划智能体，按需选择检查项目以在预算约束下实现CN/MCI/AD分类。
AI.motivation: AD诊断需在异质检查成本和患者负担下序贯获取证据，固定模态预测器无法联合决定获取何种检查及证据何时足以诊断。
AI.method: 采用掩码感知序数模型沿CN-MCI-AD有序连续体建模不确定性；用回顾性训练记录为基于能量的教师模型采样Bellman目标，将其动作分布蒸馏至Qwen策略；部署时智能体在可用性与预算约束下选择获取或诊断动作，每次获取后更新证据与序数信念。
AI.result: 在ADNI上以平均获取成本50.46美元达到77.70% Macro-F1，较最强基线高9.34个百分点；全模态评估仅提升1.89个点，但获取成本增加116.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持选择性获取检查以实现成本有效的AD诊断。

title: Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory
summary: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

AI.tldr: 本文为指数稳定向量自回归模型在重尾噪声下的最小二乘估计建立了非渐近样本复杂度界，并推广到次指数和次高斯噪声。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多假设噪声为轻尾分布，而实际中重尾噪声更常见，且需要从单条轨迹进行非渐近分析。
AI.method: 假设噪声独立同分布、协方差有界且持续激励，在噪声具有有界p阶矩（p>2）的条件下推导估计误差界；提出统一的样本复杂度分析方法，并应用于自回归外生输入模型。
AI.result: 估计误差上界为$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$，其中T为样本数，r为噪声维度；当噪声为次指数或次高斯分布时也可得到相应误差界；在自回归外生输入模型中，误差界的维度因子独立于模型阶数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为重尾噪声下VAR模型的非渐近分析提供了理论工具，并揭示了误差与样本量、噪声维度及矩条件的关系。

title: Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics
comment: Paper accepted at accepted at IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. DOI: 10.1109/TITS.2026.3711756
summary: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据与机器学习运维（DataOps与MLOps）的研究现状、关键组件、工具及案例，旨在提升效率、可靠性与决策精度。
AI.motivation: ITS&L快速发展依赖数据、AI与ML集成，但现有文献在DataOps与MLOps及其可信性方面存在空白，需系统梳理以指导实践与研究。
AI.method: 通过全面文献综述，识别研究空白，探讨DataOps与MLOps的复杂性、必要性、核心组件、可用工具、实践洞察及ITS&L相关案例，并分析AI可信性的方法与工具。
AI.result: 总结了DataOps与MLOps在ITS&L中的关键作用、实施要点及可信AI的增强手段，提供了面向真实场景的案例与工具分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为ITS&L中DataOps与MLOps建立了基础理解，并指出了持续挑战与未来方向，为研究者、从业者和政策制定者提供了重要参考，推动更高效、可持续且可信的智能交通与物流系统发展。

title: Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky
summary: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

AI.tldr: 语言模型学到的概念嵌入的几何结构（圆环、鞍形流形等）可统一解释为底层词共现统计在任意有限群、紧群或齐性空间对称性下的不可约表示矩阵元。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将月份、星期等概念的圆环和Pringle流形几何归因于阿贝尔格点上的平移对称性，作者希望证明更一般的对称性（任意有限群、紧群、齐性空间）也能导致同样结构化的嵌入几何，从而统一解释多种观察到的表示结构。
AI.method: 从群不变性出发进行理论推导：若某词族的共现统计在群G下不变，则学到的词嵌入由G的不可约表示的矩阵元构成；循环群对应Fourier模式（即圆环/Pringle）。并在三个实验场景中验证：(i) Z12月份数据恢复圆形几何；(ii) 二面体群作用于大小三和弦，统一音乐理论中T/I群与机器学习中学到的五度圈；(iii) 将LLM中天体的球面表示解释并复现为球谐嵌入。
AI.result: 理论上证明了群不变共现统计导致嵌入为不可约表示矩阵元，循环群给出Fourier几何。实验上：月份恢复已知圆形结构；和弦嵌入中T/I群作用自然导出五度圈；LLM天体表示被解释并复现为球谐嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 学习表示的几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的直接结果，该理论将多种看似无关的嵌入结构（圆、Pringle、球面）统一在群表示框架下。

title: ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.

AI.tldr: 提出ITC-MoE，一种面向MoE扩散语言模型的重要性引导、token感知压缩框架，在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算与存储开销。
AI.motivation: MoE扩散语言模型专家参数量巨大，导致计算与存储成本高昂；现有低秩压缩方法多采用静态分解与固定秩分配，忽略了MoE扩散语言模型的两个特性：跨模式非均匀冗余（输入、输出、专家模式间参数冗余与秩截断敏感性不同）和token级利用差异（热token与冷token的谱特性和专家激活模式不同）。
AI.method: ITC-MoE包含两个互补组件：1）重要性引导自适应Tucker压缩（IATC），将激活与梯度重要性引入专家权重变换，跨多个模式联合分解专家权重，并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩；2）Token感知补偿与路由（TCR），对压缩敏感的热token施加轻量低秩补偿，并针对路由模式集中的冷token限制候选专家集合。
AI.result: 在SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32上，30%压缩预算下MultiArith准确率保持96.33%，端到端加速最高达7.22倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将压缩能力与推理执行同时适配参数冗余和token级变化，ITC-MoE能在保持MoE扩散语言模型生成质量的前提下显著降低计算与存储成本。

title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

AI.tldr: 提出StepRS-GRPO，一种用于扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的逐步风险敏感强化学习微调方法，通过在不同去噪状态调整组优势变换的风险系数来提升数学推理能力与答案多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过并行去噪生成文本，而可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）会跨这些决策复用终端反馈，但各决策的条件上下文不断变化，导致优势分配不匹配。
AI.method: StepRS-GRPO在保留底层训练器的同时，使组优势变换的风险系数随去噪状态变化；对二值奖励，该变换等价于对中心化结果优势进行提示与状态相关的重缩放。基于能力的校准给出系数尺度，端点与插值消融指导调度选择，并在多个dLLM骨干和数学推理基准上验证。
AI.result: 在多个dLLM骨干和数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO相比中心化GRPO提升了pass@1准确率和pass@k覆盖率，并增加了答案多样性；消融中，质量匹配控制支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，且将优势的均方根（RMS）匹配到中心化GRPO后增益仍存在。
AI.conclusion: StepRS-GRPO通过状态相关的风险敏感优势变换有效提升了dLLM的数学推理性能与多样性；推理轨迹诊断进一步表明多样性增益不仅限于最终答案字符串。

title: Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data
summary: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无标签的家庭用电分解系统，结合事件检测和问卷引导估计，将30分钟智能电表数据分解为9类电器用电，在多个数据集上实现最低整体分解误差。
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表仅记录30分钟分辨率用电，无法捕捉家用电器级用电，需分解以提供节能和移峰建议。
AI.method: 无标签分解系统：对高功率负载进行事件检测，结合问卷引导估计，将使用数据分解为9个电器类别。
AI.result: 在四个数据集（校准家庭、UK-DALE、REFIT、2968户爱尔兰消费者超4800年数据）上，相比两个独立开发的分解系统，混合方法在所有建筑上达到最低整体分解误差，月级性能在54个配对月上更优（p<0.001，Holm校正）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效分解智能电表数据，提供家庭能耗模式建议及部分电器的节能或移峰指导。

title: Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models
summary: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

AI.tldr: 系统评估4比特量化与QLoRA在多种蛋白质语言模型上的表现，发现多数任务可保留绝大部分性能并显著节省显存，但效果依赖模型与任务配置。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）在序列生成与性质预测中应用广泛，但其规模导致微调与部署成本高昂；量化与参数高效微调对性能、表征与生成的影响尚未充分表征。
AI.method: 在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1上评估4比特量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）；对ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3进行无条件生成评估，结合表征层分析、token级输出分布与序列/结构指标。
AI.result: 多数模型-任务对保留超过90%的全量微调性能，最大模型峰值GPU显存节省接近90%；QLoRA常保留早期层表征并在中后层诱导任务特异适配；生成任务中4比特量化基本保留预测的结构与序列性质，但token级分析显示自回归输出分布存在模型依赖的偏移。
AI.conclusion: QLoRA与4比特量化可降低PLM计算需求，尤其节省显存；QLoRA可作为显存受限适配的首选策略，全量微调保留给困难任务、不稳定架构或低验证恢复场景；生成模型需在序列与结构指标外补充分布分析，且需模型与任务特定验证。

title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
summary: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出DAYJOB基准，包含医疗（50项）和金融（80项）共130项专业任务，每项任务有专家评分标准，用于评估AI代理完成实际专业工作的能力。
AI.motivation: 现实专业工作常由简短请求启动，需从业者自行判断需求、相关文档及前提是否成立，现有基准难以衡量此类完整专业工作流程。
AI.method: 构建容器化Harbor环境任务，每项任务配备二元标准专家评分表（中位数医疗47.5、金融57.5条），由代理式评判器审核交付文件，所有标准均满足才算通过；评估13个开发者的30种模型配置。
AI.result: 最强模型Claude Opus 5.5在医疗和金融任务通过率分别为24.7%和23.9%，中位数配置仅0.6%和2.5%；案例显示代理会接受与记录矛盾的前提，并在一致分析中沿用错误输入。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI代理在真实专业任务上表现有限，DAYJOB可揭示其前提验证与输入正确性缺陷；已发布全部医疗任务、50项金融任务、评估工具和排行榜。

title: ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2
summary:
Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，结合Walsh交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计，探究ESM-2表征层级中高阶上位性信息的保留程度，但对GB1适应度景观的复制实验未能稳健复现初始的高阶-低阶保留差异。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质基础模型虽支持突变效应与结构预测，但预测性能本身无法揭示模型深度中可访问的生物学交互信息的类型；作者追问ESM-2在其表征层级中是否像保留一阶、二阶信息那样强地保留高阶上位性信息。
AI.method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，将基于Walsh的交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计相结合；先在具有已知交互结构的合成景观上验证，再将冻结的ESM-2表征应用于密集的四位点GB1适应度景观。
AI.result: 初始生产运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO=-0.107）；在匹配GPU硬件与相同critic种子的完整测量网格独立复制中，该对比大幅缩小（Δ_HO-LO=-0.017），且在同一训练critic上采用其他可辩护的评估配对选择时符号不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。
AI.conclusion: 目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性地丢失高阶上位性信息，也不能断言各阶保留程度相等；方向性问题仍悬而未决。测量协议本身（包括已记录的去除池化critic中位置子集捷径）仍经验证且不受该发现影响；ORBIT-FMIB可作为探测蛋白质基础模型交互结构的诊断框架，而本次复制结果说明此类探测需具备足够统计功效的可重复性检验，才能将其输出视为生物学发现。

title: ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

AI.tldr: ProtoFlow 提出将向量量化码本作为流匹配的先验，结合 VQ 自编码与原型先验流匹配，实现高效且非自回归的多变量时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: 现有 VQ 预测方法依赖自回归 token 生成，存在曝光偏差和训练-推理不匹配；流匹配虽是非自回归替代，但通常从通用高斯先验初始化。作者观察到训练后的 VQ 码本已捕捉代表性潜在原型，可提供更有信息量的先验。
AI.method: ProtoFlow 首先将多变量序列映射到离散潜在空间，然后从学习到的码本构建结构化先验，最后学习基于 DiT 的整流流，以历史观测为条件，将样本从该先验传输到未来潜在表示。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ProtoFlow 持续取得更优的预测性能，同时保持高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 用学习到的原型先验替代通用噪声初始化，ProtoFlow 避免了自回归 token 预测的展开不匹配，并促进更快训练收敛，验证了码本先验在流匹配预测中的有效性。

title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

AI.tldr: 提出LabBook，一种单智能体发现框架，通过智能体维护的记忆引导证据检索和程序生成，在保留完整实验历史的同时构建选择性上下文，在多个任务上优于进化基线。
AI.motivation: 进化方法从少量祖先生成新程序，上下文可控但会遗漏其他实验的有用证据；包含完整实验历史则上下文冗长冗余。需要一种方法分离完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建。
AI.method: 构建单智能体发现框架，核心是LabBook——智能体维护的记忆，兼具两个作用：从完整实验日志中引导相关证据检索，并指导新解生成。每次迭代中，同一智能体结合记忆与检索证据，联合生成下一个程序并更新LabBook，无需显式种群或分支搜索结构。
AI.result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题上，LabBook在两个骨干模型下均提升了质量-成本权衡，优于所评估的进化基线；在九个额外的数学、系统和启发式设计任务上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LabBook通过记忆机制有效分离完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建，以简单单智能体框架实现了优于进化基线的发现性能，代码将开源。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety
summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TRACE方法，通过token级对比擦除目标约束多轮对话轨迹风险，在35个模型-攻击组合中均取得最低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐的大语言模型在单轮请求中会拒绝有害内容，但当同一目标分散到多轮对话中时却会服从，而偏好目标只对单轮提示的整体回复打分，其训练损失无法控制未见历史下的风险。
AI.method: 作者给出充分条件，说明在监督单轮上下文中的抑制可对多轮轨迹风险形成上界，该上界涵盖覆盖度、迁移松弛和泄漏，并刻画相对基策略风险预算的收缩；据此提出TRACE，在安全回复上按拒绝可归因优势的折扣回报对每个token加权，优势由冻结参考模型与其拒绝消融副本比较得到，使较早回复token获得后续拒绝相关证据的信用；在被拒回复的高差距位置，将观测token与策略选择的替代项结合为擦除目标，并用梯度范数惩罚替代保留集。
AI.result: 在五个开放权重模型和七种多轮攻击上，TRACE在全部35个模型与攻击配对中取得最低攻击成功率，同时在MMLU和HellaSwag上的模型效用最多下降1.23分。
AI.conclusion: TRACE将单轮抑制到多轮轨迹风险的界转化为可训练的token级目标，在显著降低多轮攻击成功率的同时基本保持模型通用能力，源代码见补充材料。

title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习动作感知时间表征的无监督技能发现方法，通过双模拟使技能在不同布局间具有不变行为，实现强分布外泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法依赖专家数据或泛化能力有限，难以迁移到未见过的布局；核心挑战是学习既能捕捉环境时间结构又对布局变化鲁棒的表征。
AI.method: 设计满足功能等变性并保留局部时间结构的目标函数来学习动作感知时间表征；基于该嵌入，利用双模拟进行无监督技能发现，将技能行为仅条件化于直接影响其执行的状态特征子集，从而强制跨布局行为不变。
AI.result: 综合实证评估表明，在给定环境中学习到的技能可有效应用于各种环境布局下的下游任务，展现出强分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过动作感知时间表征与双模拟技能发现，实现了跨布局可迁移技能，验证了无监督技能发现用于泛化预训练策略的有效性。

title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出PPO-HRAP混合机制感知策略，将PPO学习动作与基于波动率的机制先验目标敞口融合，用于在趋势性资产上兼顾收益参与和回撤控制。
AI.motivation: 强化学习交易难以平衡上行参与与回撤控制：仅优化收益的策略在上涨漂移资产上易退化为被动多头敞口，而过度风险惩罚的奖励在波动期又过于保守。
AI.method: 智能体同时观测市场特征与组合状态变量；奖励由组合对数收益、VIX条件化的回撤增幅惩罚、目标敞口偏离和换手成本组成；最终动作是PPO actor输出与机制推导目标敞口的混合。
AI.result: 在2020-2022 SPY留出测试窗口上，总收益27.62%、年化8.48%、Sharpe 0.6447、Sortino 0.8588、Calmar 0.4592，最大回撤从买入持有的34.10%降至18.47%；五个随机种子均总收益0.2725±0.0109、Sharpe 0.6219±0.0565；在QQQ和DIA的单次跨资产测试中总收益与Sharpe均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将学习动作与波动率感知的机制先验混合可有效改善风险调整后交易表现，但当前策略换手率仍偏高，且SPY之外的跨资产稳健性仅来自单次运行证据。

title: Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurReps 2026: Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究hZACH-ViT中曲率与坐标尺度、logit温度及数值保护的交互，发现Poincaré曲率在固定c=1时降低对抗攻击成功率但清洁性能差，而改变曲率会翻转解释，表明结果依赖实现细节。
AI.motivation: 曲率常被视为表示的固有属性，但其经验效果也取决于坐标尺度、学习到的logit温度与数值保护，作者试图探究这种交互在视觉Transformer原型头中的表现。
AI.method: 在hZACH-ViT（紧凑ViT，含欧氏、Poincaré和球面原型头）上，匹配主干、初始化、每类50样本训练子集和优化协议，在三个MedMNIST数据集和五个种子上进行实验；固定曲率c=1比较，并进行端到端曲率干预（如将Poincaré曲率降至c=0.1），使用PGD和CE+DLR多重重启攻击评估。
AI.result: 在c=1时，Poincaré在所有12个数据集-预算单元中类别宏PGD攻击成功率最低，且在三个数据集上CE+DLR攻击下也最低，但清洁MacroF1也最低；将曲率降至c=0.1时，15个配对种子-数据集比较中清洁MacroF1均提升并消除硬边界裁剪，但在OrganAMNIST上强攻击成功率从89.7%升至99.3%（配对差异+9.57点，95%分层自助CI [+5.52,+14.03]）；c=1时40-47%清洁Poincaré特征被硬裁剪，径向雅可比近零，无量纲攻击轨迹异常长且低效；球面头作为对照，其曲率变化是精确尺度规范，攻击差异小得多。
AI.conclusion: 结果并未确立内在双曲鲁棒性，而是识别出一个实现敏感区域，其中曲率、尺度和接近Poincaré边界共同组织清洁识别与对抗表示运动。

title: An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules
summary: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化OWL本体ECMO，作为跨部门灾害风险减少与响应的参考，并演示其从非结构化新闻构建知识图谱的端到端流程。
AI.motivation: 灾害风险减少与响应领域缺乏跨部门、统一的本体参考，导致知识表示与集成不一致。
AI.method: ECMO采用模块化OWL本体设计，核心模块ECMO-CORE利用本体设计模式和OWL2 punning技术区分灾害类型与事件表现；领域模块（如公共卫生模块）与SNOMED CT和ICD-11对齐；并以JRC的Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources系统数据构建端到端管道，从非结构化流行病新闻填充ECMO合规知识图谱。
AI.result: 初步结果表明，ECMO为一致且统一的知识表示与集成提供了必要的形式化约束。
AI.conclusion: ECMO可作为跨部门灾害风险管理的模块化本体参考，公开可用（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20070268，CC BY 4.0许可）。

title: Grand Canonical Generators
summary: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

AI.tldr: 提出巨正则生成器（GCG）框架，将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展到巨正则系综，支持变粒子数系统的生成建模。
AI.motivation: 传统玻尔兹曼生成器局限于正则系综（固定粒子数），无法直接处理粒子数可变的巨正则系综，而后者对吸附、相平衡等场景至关重要。
AI.method: 设计两种方案：1）以化学势为条件，用变尺寸生成模型联合采样粒子数与构型；2）将巨正则分布分解为粒子数分布与对应正则玻尔兹曼密度，正则部分复用现有生成器，化学势线性依赖解析编码，得到可计算似然并支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。
AI.result: 在Lennard-Jones流体和甲烷在沸石中的吸附上，GCG准确重现巨正则可观测量，跨化学势泛化良好，并通过SNIS与巨正则蒙特卡洛实现校正。
AI.conclusion: GCG为巨正则系综提供了高效、可扩展的生成建模途径，可结合现有玻尔兹曼生成器与SNIS提升精度。

title: Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents
summary: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对模块化智能体的声明特定验证审计协议，通过评分证据而非任务总分来诊断组件价值。
AI.motivation: 传统聚合任务分数无法判断改进是否可达成、哪个组件损失价值以及智能体自身检查能证明什么。
AI.method: 审计为每个结论记录证据、四种判定（支持、不支持、未解决、未评估）及成立边界；用三种工具提供证据：Oracle策略测量可达成改进，逐一替换组件为完美对应物定位价值损失，单独测试验证器分数是否标识其声称界定的量。
AI.result: 在合成市场受限投资组合分配智能体上：完美制度信息的价值取决于测量所用动作集；场景生成器丢弃大部分制度信号而更高局部保真度不改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而无可见结果变化。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于协议及其强制执行的证据区分；实证发现仅特定于所研究的智能体与环境。

title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
summary: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillSpec两阶段框架，通过共识门控演化与表示特化，解决LLM智能体自然语言技能优化中内容更新与结构化组织分离的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将技能视为静态产物或单体文档，仅优化文本内容，未显式建模程序性知识的检索与执行结构；需区分“保留什么知识”与“如何组织知识”，先以执行证据验证文本更新，再按程序依赖与检索需求组织知识。
AI.method: SkillSpec包含两阶段：共识门控演化阶段，互补编辑意图生成完整候选技能，仅当配对评估达到共识（总体充分提升且每次重复评估的聚合配对增益非负）时提交更新；表示特化阶段，从完整优化轨迹（含接受与拒绝候选）提取过程与冗余敏感信号，指导选择扁平、图或混合表示。
AI.result: 在六个基准和三个目标语言模型上，SkillSpec相较SkillOpt平均成功率提升6.89%（三模型平均）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能演化与表示特化解决互补目标：决定保留何种知识以及如何为推理组织知识。

title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
summary: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出生成溯源基座，用于合成训练数据的因果归因，并在日本护理交接管道中审计。
AI.motivation: 将模型行为归因于合成训练数据，需先知道每个训练项的生产过程，而波形-标签对无法保留此知识。
AI.method: 提出生成溯源基座，绑定源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、审核谱系和不可变清单身份；在私有日语护理交接管道中审计113项资产、1.552小时合成语音，覆盖六个场景族。
AI.result: 所有项有链接音频、转录、候选笔记和事实清单，但人类证据选择性且源特定；两个仅忠实清单场景种子不相交且不可变版本，但精确上游归因受阻于浮动生成器别名、缺失每片段TTS和代码戳、未版本化检查提示。
AI.conclusion: 生成溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件：定义候选因果图和审计单元，而贡献归因仍需冻结训练运行和干预或影响证据；论文贡献紧凑溯源契约、审计协议和有界案例研究，不声称因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开释放。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）进行算法、定理、药物等新颖发现时，历史迭代种群与最终发现成功率的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动发现依赖提示LLM迭代优化目标的工具（harness），但发现成功对harness设计敏感且脆弱，且存在模式崩溃导致迭代多样性骤降的常见失败模式；主流harness及多样性干预效果不稳定，因此需要探究早期发现与最终成功的关系并设计通用干预。
AI.method: 将已有harness设计工作推广，构建包含12种harness的'Modular'套件，在5个多样化发现任务上表征其性能；识别模式崩溃现象；分析早期发现性能与最终成功的预测关系；提出一种通用干预：先进行并行探索阶段以初始化后续迭代优化。
AI.result: 发现成功脆弱且对harness设计敏感；模式崩溃导致迭代多样性急剧下降；流行SOTA harness和多样性诱导干预收益不一致；早期发现性能可预测最终成功；所提并行探索初始化方法在多种harness和目标应用上带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 初始化在LLM驱动发现中至关重要，通过早期并行探索初始化迭代优化可稳定提升发现成功率。

title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
summary: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出Gacha Decoding，一种利用指令遵循能力和外部随机数生成器实现语言模型多样化生成的推理时方法，随模型能力提升而扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有生成多样性方法依赖语言模型的token熵，但模型能力增强时token熵和多样性反而下降，存在多样性与模型能力之间的长期矛盾。
AI.method: 将多样性视为指令遵循问题，结合语言模型的指令遵循能力与外部RNG工具的随机性，通过“用骰子规划”的方式识别并实现响应空间中的不同模式。
AI.result: 在开放域任务（野外聊天、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding在同等质量下显著优于现有方法（Vendi最高提升2.4倍），以少一个数量级以上的样本（11.0倍）达到相同数量的高质量模式，并发现其他方法无法呈现的新模式。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循而非仅token熵可以驱动生成多样性，Gacha Decoding逆转了多样性与模型能力之间的紧张关系，模型作为指令遵循者越强，多样性持续提升。

title: Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data
summary:
Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对混合流形数据的拉回几何，将单高斯潜分布推广为高斯混合，使测地线优先穿越高似然区域，并在归一化流中实现。
AI.motivation: 现有可扩展拉回几何假设数据接近单一流形、采用单模态高斯潜分布，对多模态数据需大幅传输变形，几何质量受损。
AI.method: 用潜高斯混合定义度量为其责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方，证明其光滑正定且单分量时退化为原高斯构造；对结构化重叠混合给出对数密度沿测地线凹性的条件及局部曲率关系；在自适应混合学习的归一化流中实例化，支持分量重构与局部有效维估计。
AI.result: 在合成几何数据、已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像设置和MNIST上，减少了传输畸变，路径支撑具有竞争力，能紧贴参考轨迹恢复，并提升插值真实感。
AI.conclusion: 将可扩展拉回几何从接近单一流形的数据扩展到混合流形数据，同时保持局部结构的可处理性与可解释性。

title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
summary: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM框架，以范畴论为基础度量并改进多模态类比中的关系对齐，并在视觉隐喻生成上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有AI多模态类比生成缺乏可解释的度量，无法判断生成结果是否理解并保持了跨域的关系结构。
AI.method: PRISM将类比表示为基于范畴论的显式关系映射，用VLM跨模态实例化结构；其pullback分数从图表示量化关系对齐，并作为上下文反馈信号驱动迭代精炼循环，逐步修改生成图像以增强关系深度。
AI.result: 在AnaloBench上仅凭pullback分数选正确类比达82.5%准确率；VLM评判与人工评估显示PRISM在隐喻一致性和类比适当性上优于零样本生成，57.65%成对比较中人类偏好精炼结果；但定性分析发现精炼可能偏向视觉拥挤的构图而非真正更深的关系对应。
AI.conclusion: pullback分数能有效捕捉关系信息并作为可解释反馈提升多模态类比生成，但迭代精炼存在以视觉复杂度替代关系深度的风险。

title: WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing
summary: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WOMBAT基准，包含14个手工设置消息传递权重的白盒GNN，每个模型检测特定的SMARTS基序，以提供归因的真实标签，用于评估GNN事后解释器并识别其错误。
AI.motivation: 当GNN解释器对分子产生意外归因时，仅凭归因无法判断是解释器失败还是模型学到了捷径，因此需要一个具有已知决策规则的基准来评估解释器。
AI.method: 构建WOMBAT基准，包含14个白盒GNN，每个模型的消息传递权重手工设置以检测特定SMARTS基序，决策规则已知，从而提供归因地面真值；在数百万PubChem分子上验证模型，并评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients等事后解释器；基于定性分析构造一个模型使Integrated Gradients的归因分散到整个图。
AI.result: 验证了模型的有效性，并评估了多种解释器；发现了一个模型虽能可靠检测目标基序，但导致Integrated Gradients将归因分散到整个图。
AI.conclusion: 发布数据集、模型和评估代码，以帮助研究人员开发新的GNN可解释性工具。

title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
summary: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

AI.tldr: 提出AiSearch多模态检索框架，利用视觉语言模型零样本能力实现图像和视频的自然语言搜索，并支持交互式细化与模型基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现代检索系统需兼顾自动化与交互性，支持用户实时搜索和细化结果。
AI.method: 基于视觉语言模型（VLMs）的零样本能力，构建灵活的多模态检索框架AiSearch，支持自然语言搜图搜视频、通过用户反馈交互式细化结果以及多VLM视觉基准测试。
AI.result: AiSearch实现了图像和视频的自然语言搜索、交互式结果细化，并允许用户跨多个VLM进行视觉基准测试以选择最适合任务的模型。
AI.conclusion: AiSearch框架提升了多模态检索的灵活性和交互性，借助VLM零样本能力满足个性化搜索需求。

title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
comment: Accepted to World Models in Physical AI Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://jepa-ttt.github.io/
summary: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出JEPA-TTT，在测试时通过自监督学习调整预训练世界模型的潜在动力学预测器，以适应动态变化，无需目标图像或环境奖励，显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在测试时动态与训练时不同时预测不可靠，需要在线适应。
AI.method: 固定视觉编码器和奖励头，仅用密集回放（所有时间偏移的预测窗口）持续自监督更新动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的潜在动力学预测器，跨回合累积更新，规划无需目标图像或在线奖励。
AI.result: 在四个连续控制环境的八种动态变化中均提升规划；500个测试回合后，自回归潜在预测误差平均降低83%，规划性能比冻结JEPA世界模型提升153%。
AI.conclusion: 持续自监督测试时训练能使预训练潜在世界模型适应动态变化。

title: Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers
summary: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了脉冲Transformer性能不足的根源在于脉冲神经元和脉冲自注意力（SSA）的低通滤波特性导致高频信息耗散，并提出脉冲对比注意力（SCA）范式以增强高频信息，从而提升性能并降低复杂度。
AI.motivation: 脉冲Transformer结合了SNN的能效与自注意力的表征能力，但与ANN对应模型相比仍存在性能差距。先前工作多归因于二值激活，本文则旨在揭示其真正原因并寻求解决方案。
AI.method: 通过多尺度频谱分析，发现脉冲神经元和SSA均表现为低通滤波器，导致高频成分耗散。受生物视觉系统边缘检测和差分感知特性启发，提出SCA范式：通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型，并应用局部差分细化，以有效增强高频信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SCA是一个通用模块，在图像分类、语义分割和基于事件的跟踪任务中均能持续提升脉冲Transformer的性能；同时其复杂度更低，效率优于原始SSA。
AI.conclusion: SCA有望成为节能脉冲Transformer的基础构建模块，为解决其性能瓶颈提供了新思路。

title: Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations
summary: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

AI.tldr: 首个基于真实气象站观测的生成式天气数据同化对照基准，利用美国11,849个NOAA MADIS站及四个变量，固定数据集、观测算子和网络架构，比较扩散与流匹配、像素与潜空间及推理条件策略，并与3D-Var对比。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式数据同化评估多基于合成观测或不同数据集与评估方式，难以判断哪些设计选择真正提升真实数据同化性能。
AI.method: 在真实NOAA MADIS站点观测上构建受控基准：固定数据集、观测算子与深度学习架构，对比扩散与流匹配、像素与潜空间形式、多种推理条件策略，并以经典3D-Var为基线。
AI.result: 学习生成先验优于3D-Var高斯先验（相对ERA5的RMSE降低35.7% vs 33.3%），且推理不使用ERA5背景场；全梯度引导持续优于停止梯度与初始噪声优化；扩散与流匹配在匹配条件下几乎相同，潜空间变量混合无显著增益；稀疏站点下生成式AI与全梯度引导优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 明确了生成式天气数据同化中真正提升真实站点观测性能的关键组件，并建立标准化基准供后续研究使用。

title: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now undertake increasingly complex tasks, but the way they organize interaction history into memory does not ensure a coherent understanding of the current world. We introduce PoS, an inference-time framework that constructs and continually maintains explicit belief states as the agent's decision context. Each belief combines an estimate of the current world state with unresolved task requirements, making explicit what the agent still needs to learn and accomplish. To keep this belief reliable and actionable, PoS validates its consistency and monitors task progress to detect Belief Trapping, where the agent continues to act without making meaningful progress toward the goal. Recovery is then tailored to both the trapping pattern and the type of unresolved task requirement. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning execution and diagnosis show that PoS achieves the highest overall performance on every benchmark with all three LLM backbones. Ablations demonstrate the importance of consistency validation and recovery, while context-scaling experiments show resilience to context growth. Together, these results support belief construction and continual maintenance as a foundation for long-horizon context management beyond history retention and compression.

AI.tldr: 提出PoS，一种在推理时构建并持续维护显式信念状态的框架，将当前世界状态估计与未解决任务需求结合，以提升LLM智能体的长时程上下文管理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体将交互历史组织为记忆的方式无法保证对当前世界形成连贯理解，容易导致智能体在未取得实质进展时继续行动（Belief Trapping）。
AI.method: PoS在推理时构建并持续维护显式信念状态作为决策上下文；每个信念融合当前世界状态估计与未解决任务需求；通过验证信念一致性、监控任务进度来检测Belief Trapping，并依据陷阱模式与未解决需求类型进行针对性恢复。
AI.result: 在覆盖执行与诊断的四项基准上，PoS在三种LLM骨干模型下均取得最高总体性能；消融实验证明一致性验证与恢复机制的重要性；上下文扩展实验显示其对上下文增长具有韧性。
AI.conclusion: 信念构建与持续维护可作为长时程上下文管理的基础，超越单纯的历史保留与压缩。

title: Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation
summary: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 提出仅以奖励和动作为条件的基于奖励的策略，实现观测空间完全不同的环境间零样本迁移，并在多个任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络策略在新环境中适应困难且需大量样本，而人类能快速适应，因此探索不依赖观测的零样本迁移方法。
AI.method: 设计一种仅以奖励和动作为输入的策略，讨论其挑战与可行性，并提出实际训练算法。
AI.result: 在Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing中训练的策略，可零样本迁移至不同颜色、3D渲染或Habitat-Sim中Stretch机器人导航等完全不同的观测环境；该策略还能指导目标环境中基于观测的策略训练。
AI.conclusion: 基于奖励的策略能实现跨观测空间的零样本迁移，并可作为目标环境策略训练的引导。

title: SpikeMoE: Brain-Inspired Competitive Routing for Flexible Spiking Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation through biologically inspired dynamics at the neuronal scale, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perform conditional computation through expert selection at the model scale. Integrating their strengths offers potential for flexible neural architectures. A key challenge, however, lies in designing an expert selection mechanism based on spiking activity. To address this, we introduce a spike-based k-WTA Router inspired by competition-inhibition observed in the hippocampal CA1 region. The router incorporates lateral inhibition and refractory period to select Top-K experts according to discrete spike counts. Building on this, we present SpikeMoE, a framework that integrates neuronal-scale spiking dynamics with model-scale expert selection. To address incomplete multisensory inputs in multimodal tasks, we further equip SpikeMoE with a two-stage missing-modality modeling module that combines empirical prototypes from an observed-modality pool with modality-specific learnable embeddings to construct missing-modality representations. Experiments on vision, language, and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that SpikeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance among the SNN baselines, matches or exceeds the performance of ANN counterparts, and maintains robustness across diverse missing-modality conditions. These results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between performance and energy efficiency, validating the integration of spiking dynamics with sparse expert computation and highlighting SpikeMoE as a promising approach to energy-efficient brain-inspired computing.

AI.tldr: 提出SpikeMoE，将脉冲神经网络（SNN）的神经元级脉冲动态与专家混合（MoE）的模型级条件计算相融合，通过脉冲k-WTA路由器实现基于脉冲活动的专家选择，并针对多模态任务设计缺失模态建模模块。
AI.motivation: SNN具备事件驱动计算优势，MoE具备条件计算优势，但如何基于离散脉冲活动设计专家选择机制是融合二者的关键挑战。
AI.method: 受海马CA1区竞争-抑制现象启发，设计脉冲k-WTA路由器，利用侧抑制和不应期依据离散脉冲计数选择Top-K专家；构建SpikeMoE框架；针对多模态缺失输入，采用两阶段缺失模态建模模块，结合观测模态池的经验原型与模态特定可学习嵌入来构建缺失模态表示。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言和多模态基准上，SpikeMoE在SNN基线中达到最优性能，与ANN对应模型性能相当或更优，并在多种缺失模态条件下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SpikeMoE实现了性能与能效的良好权衡，验证了脉冲动态与稀疏专家计算融合的有效性，是面向能效类脑计算的有前景方案。

title: Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs
summary: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMILP，利用MILP的等价重构作为自监督信号，通过等变自监督学习联合训练GNN和超网络，学习变量与约束的通用表示。
AI.motivation: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）可加速求解，但存在多种等价形式；利用这些保持整数性的重构（变量替换与冗余约束）可为MILP表示学习提供自监督信号。
AI.method: 刻画对每个输入实例有效的仿射重构，区分保持变量不变的重新描述与可预测变换变量的替换；基于等变自监督学习，提出ReMILP，联合训练图神经网络和超网络以预测变量嵌入在变量替换下的变换。
AI.result: 无需求解器标签，ReMILP在未见问题类别上学习到具有预期不变性与等变性的表示；在二元解、约束活性和整数间隙预测任务中，冻结表示携带任务相关信息，并为微调提供有用初始化。
AI.conclusion: ReMILP通过等价重构自监督学习到通用MILP表示，可迁移至未见问题类别并支持下游任务。

title: A Deterministic and Auditable AI Security Risk Assessment Framework with ATLAS Aligned Executable Rules and Formal Verification
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high impact and safety critical settings, yet security assessment remains difficult to reproduce and defend under audit. Existing approaches often rely on narrative checklists or assessor driven scoring, and they lack an explicit, machine evaluable mapping from observable engineering artefacts to stable technique level outcomes. We present an evidence driven AI security assessment framework that operationalises assessment as a deterministic decision function. The framework normalises heterogeneous artefacts into a project independent Control ID taxonomy scored on a bounded four level ordinal scale, compiles technique level predicates from a pinned MITRE ATLAS snapshot via an explicit mitigation to control mapping, and outputs technique indexed feasibility and impact levels with traceable links back to the triggering evidence. We package all normative choices as a versioned assessment policy object to support repeatable reassessment across snapshots. To ensure semantic correctness, we formally verify boundedness, totality, ordered semantic consistency, and monotonicity of the compiled evaluator over the full declared score domain. We evaluate the framework on five public open source AI projects pinned to explicit repository snapshots, quantify before and after changes under a unified hardening intervention, and validate responsiveness to real engineering changes through fork based implementations of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and Continuous integration (CI) security scanning gates. Results show consistent downward shifts in feasibility profiles under strengthened observable controls, while worst case residual feasibility persists when technique specific core controls remain absent from the evidence scope.

AI.tldr: 提出一种证据驱动的AI安全评估框架，将异构工件映射到Control ID分类法，基于MITRE ATLAS快照编译技术级判定器，并形式化验证其语义属性，实现可复现的量化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全评估多依赖叙述性清单或评估者主观打分，缺乏从可观测工程工件到稳定技术级结果的显式、机器可评估映射，导致评估难以复现和审计。
AI.method: 将异构工件归一化为项目无关的Control ID分类法（四级有序量表），通过显式缓解措施到控制的映射从固定MITRE ATLAS快照编译技术级谓词，输出带证据追溯的技术可行性/影响等级，并将规范选择封装为版本化评估策略对象；同时形式化验证判定器的有界性、完全性、有序语义一致性和单调性。在五个固定快照的开源AI项目上评估，通过统一加固干预量化前后变化，并用SBOM生成和CI安全扫描门的fork实现验证响应性。
AI.result: 在加强可观测控制后，可行性剖面呈现一致的下降趋势；但当证据范围中缺少技术特定核心控制时，最坏情况下的残余可行性仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够以确定性、可追溯和可复现的方式量化AI安全评估，支持跨快照重评估，并揭示残余可行性依赖于技术核心控制是否被证据覆盖。

title: Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces
summary: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过正则化方法增强深度神经网络表示几何中的信号-噪声分解（SNF）和信号-信号分解（SSF），发现SNF正则化能提升模型在CIFAR-100和受腐蚀的BloodMNIST上的性能，而SSF则不能。
AI.motivation: 先前理论工作表明表示几何特性（如SNF和SSF）影响深度网络的推理能力，本文旨在通过训练中强化这些特性来理解它们对表示几何和性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建了增强SNF和SSF的正则化器，在CIFAR-100分类任务上与L2正则化基线比较，并在BloodMNIST数据集上应用MedMNIST-C五种严重程度的腐蚀进行测试，分析 nuisance 子空间。
AI.result: SNF正则化提升了CIFAR-100性能，但SSF没有；在BloodMNIST腐蚀数据上SNF正则化带来更大增益；SNF模型将噪声表示在独立子空间，通过估计并投影掉主要腐蚀方向可显著提高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 强制信号-噪声分解的正则化能显著提升存在分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务性能，且隔离 nuisance 变量比保持类别变量的分解表示更重要。

title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
summary: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. It then decides whether to retain or replace the token, thereby repairing early errors and extending the accepted prefix. We further jointly train the draft backbone and the selector, combining candidate-support learning with a repair objective, while weighting the repair loss according to each block position's potential contribution to the consecutive accepted prefix. Across eight diverse benchmarks on an H800 GPU, DRelay consistently improves both average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding performance over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark. Under SGLang serving, DRelay improves average end-to-end speedup over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark by 14.7%-16.8%, 8.7%-9.3%, and 8.1%-9.3%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出DRelay，通过全局信息对候选选择做前缀感知的选择性修复，从而延长接受前缀并提升推测解码效率。
AI.motivation: 并行草稿虽降低推测解码开销，但收益受接受前缀长度限制；即使正确词元已在候选池中，单个早期选择错误也会阻断后续预测被利用。
AI.method: DRelay利用整个草稿块的全局信息，在目标模型验证前进行前缀感知的候选选择修复：全局读取器提取各位置候选的预测信息，因果选择器结合候选级信息与已选前缀判断当前原生选择是否一致，并决定保留或替换；同时联合训练草稿主干与选择器，结合候选支持学习与修复目标，并按各块位置对连续接受前缀的潜在贡献加权修复损失。
AI.result: 在H800 GPU的八个基准上，DRelay在平均接受长度和端到端解码性能上持续优于DFlash、Domino和DSpark；在SGLang服务下，端到端加速分别比DFlash、Domino和DSpark提升14.7%-16.8%、8.7%-9.3%和8.1%-9.3%。
AI.conclusion: DRelay通过全局信息驱动的选择性修复有效缓解早期选择错误，延长接受前缀，并在多种基准与服务环境下稳定提升推测解码性能。

title: Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks.
