We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在自监督学习中，网络宽度与深度如何影响贪婪逐层训练与端到端反向传播的训练效果，发现宽度可弥补受限的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习训练的主流方式，但局部优化的逐层训练机制在何种网络架构条件下能达到与端到端训练相当的表征学习效果尚不明确，本文旨在自监督学习背景下回答该问题。
AI.method: 在卷积网络中，分别采用贪婪逐层自监督训练和端到端自监督训练，系统改变网络宽度和深度，比较两种训练方式的性能，并分析所形成表征的几何特性。
AI.result: 在较宽网络中，端到端反向传播相对贪婪逐层训练的优势缩小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪婪逐层训练甚至取得更高性能；非常宽的贪婪训练网络表现出比端到端反向传播网络更有利的表征几何。
AI.conclusion: 网络宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配，表征几何差异是贪婪逐层训练性能提升的潜在机制。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Personalized Health Checkup Interpretation and Guidance
summary: Personalized interpretation of health checkup results requires reasoning across longitudinal records, medical knowledge, lifestyle guidance, and healthcare navigation. We present a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system that identifies multiple intents, maps each to a task-specific agent, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs. We compared answers generated in Single Agent and Multi Agent settings on 120 Korean compound queries combining two to four requirements, using synthetic health checkup records. The Multi Agent improved the weighted LLM-judge score from 1.695 to 1.797 (p = 0.027), and three additional LLM judges showed consistent improvements ($Δ$ = +0.111 to +0.186, all p < 0.05). The gains came from usefulness, consistency, and the handling of every requirement in compound queries, whereas numerical accuracy and grounding improved significantly under only one of the four judges and medical safety did not differ, and critical failures occurred at similar rates (Single Agent 15.0% vs. Multi Agent 13.3%). Two human evaluators preferred Multi Agent in 66.7% and 68.3% of pairwise comparisons. Multi Agent execution increased latency and cost by 1.31$\times$ and 2.02$\times$, respectively. In exploratory subgroup analyses, the improvement was concentrated in queries involving personal-record lookup.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种多智能体LLM系统，用于个性化解读健康体检结果，通过识别复合查询中的多个意图、分配给专用智能体并行执行并综合输出。
AI.motivation: 个性化解读体检结果需要跨纵向记录、医学知识、生活方式指导和医疗导航进行推理，单一智能体难以同时处理复合查询中的多个需求。
AI.method: 构建多智能体LLM系统，识别多个意图并映射到任务专用智能体，并行执行后综合输出；在120个韩语复合查询（含2至4个需求）上，使用合成体检记录对比单智能体与多智能体设置，并采用加权LLM评判及额外三个LLM评判和人工评估。
AI.result: 多智能体将加权LLM评判分数从1.695提升至1.797（p=0.027），三个额外LLM评判显示一致改进（Δ=+0.111至+0.186，均p<0.05）；增益来自实用性、一致性和对复合查询中每项需求的处理，而数值准确性和依据仅在四个评判中的一个下显著改善，医疗安全无差异，关键失败率相近（单智能体15.0% vs 多智能体13.3%）；两名人工评估者在66.7%和68.3%的成对比较中偏好多智能体；多智能体执行使延迟和成本分别增加1.31倍和2.02倍；探索性亚组分析显示改进集中于涉及个人记录查询的查询。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体LLM系统能有效提升复合健康体检查询的个性化解读质量，尤其利于涉及个人记录查询的场景，但需权衡延迟和成本增加，且在数值准确性、依据和医疗安全方面优势有限。

title: Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法，通过在同一环境中池化不同奖励的多个智能体的数据并利用低秩假设，实现数据覆盖要求缓解、可扩展的反事实评估与有限样本保证的奖励恢复及策略学习。
AI.motivation: 逆强化学习通过学习可迁移奖励实现修改环境下智能体的反事实评估，但目标环境改变状态占用分布，对数据覆盖有严格要求；同时多任务评估中规划计算量随任务数增长而难以扩展。
AI.method: 在低秩假设下，跨同一环境中具有不同奖励的多个智能体池化数据，进行多任务逆强化学习：每个任务无需访问所有状态，只要其他任务覆盖即可；将计算密集的规划规模与秩而非任务数关联。
AI.result: 给出奖励恢复与新环境下策略学习的有限样本保证；实验表明方法对有限覆盖鲁棒，能恢复各任务支持内外的奖励，以更低遗憾迁移到目标环境，且相对逐任务方法的计算优势随任务数增长而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在缓解覆盖要求、提升多任务可扩展评估、保持理论保证与迁移性能方面有效，并随任务规模增大展现更强的计算效率。

title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
summary: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文发现概率奖励在长推理链中的后验集中现象（PCP），并提出无验证器的RLCPR框架以提升优化稳定性和token效率。
AI.motivation: 无验证器强化学习依赖概率奖励训练LLM通用推理任务，但奖励可靠性在长程推理中未充分探索，尤其概率奖励存在长度依赖的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出RLCPR框架，包含不确定性感知数据采样（生成前减少易集中rollout）和集中感知正则化（后验奖励崩溃时惩罚过长推理链）。
AI.result: 在七个基准中的六个上，RLCPR比最先进的无验证器RL基线性能提升最高4.0%，同时token效率更高。
AI.conclusion: RLCPR通过显式处理PCP，有效提升了无验证器RL的优化稳定性和token效率，并优于现有基线。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 提出“嫁接”方法，在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将其权重更新加到后训练模型上，以低成本模拟忠实的预训练干预，减少现实漂移和能力退化。
AI.motivation: 预训练干预（如SDF）对模型对齐至关重要，但直接修改预训练语料需完整后训练才能评估，迭代慢且昂贵；而将SDF直接用于已后训练模型会引入伪影、能力下降和“现实漂移”（将虚构实体当作真实）。
AI.method: 嫁接：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，学习权重更新，然后将该更新加到已后训练模型上，无需重新后训练。在多达284B参数的多个模型家族上验证，包括安装虚假事实、训练错位模型生物和宪法中期训练干预。
AI.result: 嫁接在已后训练模型上安装目标信念的强度与SDF相当，但平均减少现实漂移和偏好一致性损失超过一半，且更接近忠实的中间训练运行。
AI.conclusion: 嫁接无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任何后续检查点，使研究者能以单次微调成本快速迭代预训练干预。

title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mmm8383/NextMe-800 ; project page: https://kkkkawayi.github.io/nextme-800/
summary: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.

AI.tldr: 提出约800小时的第一人称数据集NextMe-800及基准NextAct，用于个性化行为预测与开放词汇动作序列预测研究。
AI.motivation: 人们常事后反思若预知实际行为是否会制定不同计划，希望系统能从个人历史生成合理轨迹以辅助制定更现实计划与明智决策。
AI.method: 由一名志愿者126天约800小时的第一人称数据，含1 Hz图像、注视与音频，按从原子动作到主要活动的五级抽象层次标注；将个性化动作预测形式化为开放词汇K步序列预测，并构建结合NextMe-800与EgoLife数据集的1500点基准NextAct，采用基于嵌入的软编辑距离作为度量。
AI.result: 在不同抽象层次与预测时域上评估了不同模型预测个人行为的能力。
AI.conclusion: NextMe-800与NextAct为研究从第一人称观察能提前多久预测个人行为提供了跨月级资源与评估框架。

title: Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了随机输入-输出映射记忆任务间的迁移学习，发现了等效和非等效迁移两种模式，并通过消融实验定位了迁移来源。
AI.motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题在于预训练为何能加速或提升下游任务性能，其内在机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 以随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务为研究对象，观察预训练与下游微调间的迁移现象，并通过消融实验分解迁移效应。
AI.result: 发现两种迁移模式：等效迁移（每多一个预训练epoch约节省一个微调epoch）和非等效迁移（不匹配任务预训练比直接训练下游更高效）；迁移可分解为最后一层的“平凡”幅度驱动迁移和其他层协方差导致的“非平凡”结构驱动迁移。
AI.conclusion: 结果深化了对迁移学习机制的理解，有望指导有原则的预训练策略。

title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
summary: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling seeds. Across 24 paired runs a scalar routing probe yields no pooled improvement in routing-stratified calibration, and an entropy-profile probe predicts correctness better than the same probe given shuffled profiles yet worse than a confidence-only predictor in both binary log-loss and Brier score: a gain over shuffled traces does not become a gain over the output. Conditioning on the complete logit vector leaves the corresponding comparison unresolved. The audit bounds how far these non-detections can be read: at an injected effect of 0.010 nats the profile probe recovers 24-59% of the oracle gain, and a reference-preserving correction probe recovers 8% and 23% in the two CIFAR-100 settings, below the threshold we fixed for applying it to real labels. The results establish control-dependent gains and incomplete estimator recovery, not the absence of conditional routing information.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计路由熵是否能提供超出模型自身置信度的正确性信息，发现路由信息增益依赖于控制条件且估计器恢复不完整，不能断言不存在条件路由信息。
AI.motivation: 动态架构在预测旁留下逐样本路由轨迹，扩散路由易被解读为预测不可靠；作者检验路由熵是否携带超出模型置信度的正确性信息。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10/100上从零训练Swin-Tiny与DeiT-Small的Attention-Residual变体，加入软分箱校准辅助损失；进行三项检验（固定置信度下的路由信号、跨种子复现、留出预测器对比输出-only与打乱轨迹控制），并做敏感性审计注入已知效应以测量探针恢复比例。
AI.result: 固定30个分箱检验家族在多重校正后无显著结果，名义命中与临界结果均未在相邻种子复现；24对运行中，标量路由探针对路由分层校准无汇总改进，熵轮廓探针优于打乱轨迹但劣于仅置信度预测器（二元对数损失与Brier分数）；条件于完整logit向量时比较未定。注入0.010 nats效应时，轮廓探针恢复24-59%的oracle增益，参考保持校正探针在两个CIFAR-100设置中仅恢复8%与23%，低于应用阈值。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立的是控制依赖的增益与不完整的估计器恢复，而非条件路由信息的缺失。

title: Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability
summary: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束critic值梯度，改进准度量学习在目标条件强化学习中的局部约束。
AI.motivation: 现有准度量学习方法虽然将目标到达代价建模为准度量距离，但其局部约束未能同时反映有限时域下控制组合的方向依赖效应和环境可行性。
AI.method: 基于状态约束最优控制，将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦，二者均从数据中估计，并以此约束critic的值梯度。
AI.result: 在OGBench基准上，ReQRL优于或媲美现有准度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。
AI.conclusion: ReQRL通过有限时域可达性约束有效提升了准度量学习的性能，验证了方向依赖控制组合与环境可行性建模的重要性。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMTB-Audit基准和MTB-AuditAgent框架，解决分子肿瘤委员会中LLM对部分支持案例的过度拒绝问题。
AI.motivation: AI在精准肿瘤学中需区分真正无证据推荐与因信息不全、ECOG状态差等需医生审查的有证据选项，现有LLM存在过度拒绝的安全隐患。
AI.method: 构建500个合成非小细胞肺癌病例的基准，涵盖五类对抗错误和四种安全标签；评估八种LLM配置；开发确定性七模块MTB-AuditAgent，分离证据验证、缺失信息检测、安全分类和弃权。
AI.result: 所有LLM在83.3-100%的真实部分支持案例中丢失该标签，通过标签坍缩获得高安全分；MTB-AuditAgent将过度拒绝降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95% CI: 88.6-93.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 双肿瘤学家标注研究显示分歧集中于信息充分性与治疗优化边界，需保留临床有意义的区分，MTB-AuditAgent有效缓解过度拒绝并提升校准推理。

title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性理论刻画合成数据对LLM训练的价值权衡，并基于此设计TATC选择方法，在数学推理任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 合成数据虽被广泛用于扩展LLM训练规模，但更多合成数据未必带来更好模型，其价值取决于是否为目标任务增加相关信息且不引入抵消收益的错误，并随训练集增长而变化。
AI.method: 建立线性理论，刻画合成数据的有用性条件、最佳添加量及边际价值，判断输入覆盖是否充分或需考虑合成误差；据此提出Training-Aware Target Coverage（TATC），识别训练效应对目标任务有益的候选样本，并选择扩展目标相关方向覆盖。
AI.result: 在文本和图像数据上验证线性理论；在数学推理任务中，TATC为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct选择合成解进行微调，在不同选择预算下于GSM8K上优于其他合成数据选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化并最大化合成数据对目标任务的价值，为合成数据选择提供了有原则的方法。

title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
summary: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出MCRI四维框架及MCRI-Eval评估方法，用于系统评估智能体技能，并验证其能有效预测技能下游表现。
AI.motivation: 智能体从单工具系统演变为模块化复合架构，技能成为能力开发与分发的关键机制，但学术界缺乏对技能进行系统分析与评估的结构化框架。
AI.method: 基于信息增益与行为约束提出MCRI四维框架，并将其操作化为基于大语言模型的MCRI-Eval评估方法；使用OpenClaw技能库中63,812个公开技能，在BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental和Mind2Web上进行58,275次技能条件模型执行。
AI.result: MCRI-Eval得分与社区流行度信号正相关，在下游排序一致性上优于所评估方法；相比各基准最强基线，其选出的技能在下游性能排名上分别提升17.7、22.8和19.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MCRI-Eval为在昂贵的基于执行的评估之前优先筛选有潜力的技能提供了有效的前置信号。

title: Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases
summary: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于澳大利亚维多利亚州2020年1月至2024年3月的285万次救护车出勤数据，量化了全州范围内救护车滞留的规模、趋势及运行相关性。
AI.motivation: 救护车滞留是院前急救服务中的关键运行瓶颈，但其系统性规模与动态特征在大尺度上尚未得到充分刻画。
AI.method: 采用探索性数据分析，经过系统预处理后，分析涵盖59家设有急诊科的医院和79个地方政府区域的2,026,569次急诊转运，通过区间分解、帕累托集中度、小时互相关、医院到达并发度和优先级分层运行比较进行研究。
AI.result: 累计损失救护车小时达1,491,127小时，相当于每天损失约96个十小时救护车班次；59家医院中10家占损失小时的57.8%，对应50.9%的病例；年度损失上升57%至2022年峰值，而转运需求下降3.7%；交接时长随患者紧急程度变化不大，但随前一小时到达同一医院的救护车数量单调上升，且该效应在一天中每个小时均持续存在；小时需求与2至4小时后的滞留中度相关（r = 0.365）。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为医院状态感知的救护车路径规划奠定了实证前提。

title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
summary: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架即可作为智能体，其解覆盖度（pass@K）常优于后训练版本；后训练通过将任务推向全解或全不解的极端，提升采样效率但损失覆盖度，本文提出Sharpening Tax度量该损失并给出PTGS采样方法。
AI.motivation: 探究RL后训练是否仅锐化基座模型已有行为，并检验该权衡在需要多轮工具交互的智能体任务中是否依然成立。
AI.method: 对比14对基座/后训练模型在3个智能体基准（共42例）上的pass@1与pass@K；提出诊断指标Sharpening Tax量化后训练导致的测试时扩展性损失；提出后验温度组采样PTGS，按估计难度自适应调整每提示的采样温度，并在两个智能体环境的RL训练中应用。
AI.result: 基座模型pass@1更低但在充足测试预算下pass@K常超过后训练模型；后训练使任务趋向全解或全不解，提升采样效率与一致性却损失覆盖度；Sharpening Tax在多数设置中普遍存在，可由少量rollout估计，且与其他指标相关性良好；PTGS相比固定温度基线税更小，重复采样解出更多任务且单次准确率也提升。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练在智能体任务中并非单纯锐化，而是以解覆盖度为代价换取采样效率；Sharpening Tax可有效诊断该代价，PTGS作为即插即用的贝叶斯采样器能缓解该问题并同时提升单次与多次采样表现。

title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用超网络从少量演示中即时生成小型专用模型参数，并在ARC-1D测试床上验证其可行性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 通用模型虽能通过上下文适应多任务，但专用模型需任务特定训练或适配；作者希望探索能否直接从少量演示中生成专用模型，避免逐任务训练。
AI.method: 以ARC-1D为受控测试床，用超网络根据上下文生成单个变换对应的微型专家模型参数，并分析生成参数形成的权重空间及泛化表现。
AI.result: 生成的参数构成结构化权重空间；专家模型展现出部分组合泛化以及对训练中未见过变换的泛化；在两种设定下，移除显式任务标识符可提升超出训练变换的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 少样本任务上下文可即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，所得权重空间支持复用和对已知函数之外的泛化，构成概念验证。

title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

AI.tldr: 本文将测试时训练（TTT）框架引入离线强化学习，提出用TTT层增强决策Transformer的Decision Titan模型，在X-Maze环境中分析其长时记忆性能与机制。
AI.motivation: RNN受梯度消失与向量隐状态表达力限制，Transformer受注意力二次复杂度限制；TTT可存储情景记忆但尚未应用于强化学习，且其记忆机制缺乏分析。
AI.method: 在Decision Transformer中增加TTT层构建Decision Titan，在T-Maze扩展的X-Maze环境中测试序列记忆，并通过可视化门控值随时间的变化研究记忆学习机制。
AI.result: Decision Titan能学习比上下文窗口长20倍的长时依赖，可泛化到训练数据1.7倍的长度；时间泛化依赖所用的时间嵌入，长时依赖学习能力依赖相关信息编码方式。
AI.conclusion: TTT框架在离线RL中具有潜力，但长时记忆的有效性受时间嵌入和信息编码方式的关键影响。

title: AnyJev Technical Report
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Early report on work in development. Code: https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
summary: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

AI.tldr: AnyJev 从预训练指令微调语言模型的单次预填充中读取类型化决策，通过标签先验校正和选项列表循环旋转平均，无需梯度更新即可提升准确率并降低顺序翻转率。
AI.motivation: 当前需要类型化决策的系统依赖专门训练的模型，而预训练语言模型直接读取选项概率存在两个缺陷：模型无论输入如何都偏向某些标签，且偏向选项列表中的某些位置。
AI.method: AnyJev 将答案位置的下一个词分布限制在选项词上，除以从无标签输入估计的标签先验，并对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转平均对数概率，无需梯度步骤或参数修改；同时提出一种停止规则，在无标签状态上针对全旋转决策选择阈值，以减少所需预填充次数。
AI.result: 在两个 20 选项任务上，循环旋转将顺序翻转率从 0.33 分别降至 0.14 和 0.18，并在全部 11 个模型上提升准确率；停止规则在四个单元中的两个上以 10.6/18 次旋转达到 0.008 的验证边界，在服务运行中读取 7.3 次旋转并在 vLLM 上每秒服务 2.2 倍的决策数。
AI.conclusion: AnyJev 无需训练即可从预训练语言模型中高效读取类型化决策，并通过停止规则显著降低计算开销，代码已开源。

title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了五种视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶场景下面对视觉输入退化时的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性，并测试了视觉证据增强（VEA）推理时方法的改进效果。
AI.motivation: VLM在自动驾驶中的任务日益重要，但真实环境中视觉输入可能因传感器缺陷和环境条件而退化，影响模型预测及其置信度，而自动驾驶的安全关键决策要求模型能准确预测并识别不可靠预测。
AI.method: 选取五个VLM（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个驾驶相关QA数据集上，采用单帧、多视角、多帧和单目四种视觉输入设置，评估视觉退化对准确率和置信度可靠性的影响，并应用推理时方法视觉证据增强（VEA）检验其能否提升退化视觉条件下的模型可靠性。
AI.result: 视觉退化的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异，准确率与置信度可靠性的变化在不同条件下也不同；VEA对部分模型和数据集有性能提升，但增益并非在所有设置下一致。
AI.conclusion: VLM在退化视觉条件下的鲁棒性和置信度可靠性存在显著差异，VEA可带来一定改进但效果不具普适性，需进一步研究以提升自动驾驶中VLM的可靠性。

title: TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models
summary: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TrueMuse，一个用于文本到音乐生成数据归因的受控数据集与基准，系统评估了现有黑盒归因方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到音乐生成模型的归因方法缺乏可靠的真实标签，难以严格评估其有效性。
AI.method: 构建TrueMuse：在精心挑选的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型，提供受控归因目标；覆盖四种归因设置（旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家风格、流派模式），包含133个属性、648个微调模型、95,456个生成样本；从四个维度评估现有黑盒方法。
AI.result: 归因仍具挑战性，现有方法在不同评估设置下表现差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 需要更可靠、可泛化的文本到音乐生成归因方法。

title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
summary: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

AI.tldr: 将语义ID构建重新表述为递归聚类问题，提出统一的图信息语义ID框架GrIS，并实例化RecDMoN与RQ-GAE，在多个真实数据集上取得最高+52% Hit@10的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有语义ID（SID）工作将SID构建视为表示学习问题，即把物品编码到量化隐空间并读取码字。作者认为这一视角是偶然的，SID构建本质上是递归聚类问题，因此需要重新定义聚类对象与分配方式。
AI.method: 将SID构建建模为递归聚类，聚类对象为节点携带语义内容、边携带协同信号的图，SID分配即层次化图划分。由此提出统一框架GrIS，涵盖图构建与递归划分算法两个此前被折叠的设计轴。RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被恢复为图为空时的特例。探索两种实例：RecDMoN使用可微图池化进行层次化分配；RQ-GAE在RQ-VAE基础上扩展图感知物品表示与图重构目标。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS持续优于CF-aware的SOTA方法，Hit@10最高提升+52%。由于图构建与划分是显式、可分别配置的组件，两个轴上的改进可以组合并系统评估。
AI.conclusion: SID构建应被视为递归图聚类问题；GrIS统一并扩展了先前方法，将纯内容量化揭示为更大设计空间的一角，且其模块化设计支持在图构建与划分两个维度上系统组合与评估改进。

title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出SHARPO，一种在环境交互片段层面重新分配信用分配的机制，改进GRPO以提升LLM在多步智能体任务中的强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体强化学习采用轨迹级奖励，难以对长序列中单个决策进行信用分配，一个局部错误就可能导致任务失败，因此需要更细粒度的信用分配方法。
AI.method: SHARPO受在线自蒸馏（OPSD）启发，在环境交互片段内计算教师-学生对数概率差，据此生成有界乘数，对GRPO优势进行重新加权；该乘数在片段内所有token间共享，使不同片段获得差异化信用。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 片段级事后优势重加权能够有效细化GRPO的信用分配，提升大语言模型智能体在多步交互任务中的性能。

title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
summary: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.

AI.tldr: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求成员国在2027年前建立AI监管沙盒，但技术测试工具生态碎片化。本文提出11项架构与治理需求，并设计开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator以支持沙盒内技术测试，初步试点验证了其数据协调与报告层。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案强制建立AI监管沙盒，其中结构化技术测试需要专用基础设施，但现有工具异构、输出难以比较、追踪和复用，工具生态结构碎片化。
AI.method: 从AIRS流程条件和AI法案对高风险系统的义务中推导出11项架构与治理需求；据此构建开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator，包含通过稳定插件API访问的测试与控制目录、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、面向多学科解读的角色仪表板及受众分层报告。
AI.result: 描述了框架架构与当前版本；在真实AIRS场景中开展早期试点，运行了数据协调与报告层，并为官方退出报告做出贡献。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了路线图、目录分层贡献模型引发的治理问题，以及开源评估生态在成员国间形成的制度路径。

title: Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Supplementary material (15 pages) provided as ancillary files
summary: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($Δ$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发反事实方向测试与单调约束框架，用于检测并纠正XGBoost模型在癌症复发预测中的方向反转问题，且不影响模型性能。
AI.motivation: 临床医生预期癌症严重程度越高复发风险越高，但无约束XGBoost模型却学到更高肿瘤分期和原位癌反而预测更低复发风险，而传统判别力、校准和SHAP分析均无法察觉此反转，因此需要新的检测与纠正方法。
AI.method: 基于BOXIT多中心试验（472例患者，435例有至少两年随访，153例复发），开发反事实方向测试（逐一恶化单个有向特征，检查风险是否下降）和单调约束校正（约束方向取自EORTC和EAU风险系统），在18个预测因子（7个有向）上通过50折交叉验证，与无约束XGBoost和逻辑回归对比，并评估SHAP方向和校准。
AI.result: 肿瘤分期和原位癌与更低复发相关，与医学直觉相反；无约束模型在90.2%的病例中反转原位癌反事实，74.3%反转分期。判别力（ΔAUC 0.005, p=0.47）、校准和SHAP幅度均未察觉反转。单调约束消除了所有违反，且判别力无损失（0.723 vs 0.718），并优于EORTC（p=8.9e-16）。
AI.conclusion: 学到这种反转的模型通过了所有常规检查；反事实方向测试作为一次预指定单调约束的重新拟合，可在不损失性能的情况下捕获此类失败，应在临床部署前常规执行。

title: Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出一种五层评估协议，用于检验自动驾驶场景生成模型内部表示与车辆动力学约束的一致性，并在VAE等模型上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI生成的自动驾驶场景虽视觉逼真，但内部表示不透明且与真实车辆动力学一致性不足，缺乏形式化保证，限制了其在安全关键验证与认证中的应用。
AI.method: 设计五层评估协议：前四层通过运动学对齐、统计基线比较、潜在可控性和激活分析检查内部表示与网络层；第五层依据车辆动力学约束（如横向急动度阈值）评估模型输出。在VAE场景生成器上演示，并推广至其他生成模型。
AI.result: 标准输出级指标和可视化显示生成场景逼真，但该协议揭示模型潜在空间与运动学特征的对齐程度有限，且部分视觉上合理的轨迹不满足车辆动力学约束。
AI.conclusion: 该分层评估协议能提供比传统指标更深入的模型内部与物理一致性洞察，且不限于VAE架构，可推广至其他生成模型，有助于安全关键场景生成的认证流程。

title: Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints
summary: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种重要性引导的扰动分配机制，在共享ℓ1预算和局部幅度约束下，将扰动重新分配到模型敏感区域，从而提升攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 在共享ℓ1预算的对抗优化中，不仅要决定扰动大小，还需决定有限预算的分配位置；局部幅度约束限制了扰动集中于少数坐标，使得分配问题尤为重要。
AI.method: 利用固定的干净梯度先验作为重要性引导，设计中心化分配目标，鼓励在高于平均重要性的位置施加扰动，并抑制其他位置的不必要支出；该方法不改变可行扰动集，仅重新分配预算。
AI.result: 在十种鲁棒模型-数据集配置下，与匹配的APGD和PMA基线相比，攻击成功率提升2.52至17.70个百分点；分配分析显示高重要性区域扰动质量显著增加，而全局ℓ1消耗未增加；消融实验表明中心化非均匀重分配提供部分收益，模型导出的重要性带来额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 扰动分配是共享预算、局部约束威胁模型下对抗优化的一个独立且实际相关的维度。

title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation
summary: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly operate a published specialist model. We investigate five parts of the agent's configuration: task information, reasoning, self-verification, time budget, and backbone model. We find substantial run-to-run variability, with approximately 54% of the outcome variance coming from repeating the same configuration rather than changing it. Across configurations, the information provided to the agent has the largest effect, exceeding both time budget and model size, while also reducing cost and improving calibration. Configuration choices also interact: additional time helps only when the agent has sufficient information or a capable enough model to use it. Finally, a trajectory-based taxonomy of agent behavior reveals that prompting an agent to verify its answer has little effect on its verification behavior, whereas providing a dedicated verification tool changes that behavior substantially. These results suggest that agents should be evaluated as configurable systems themselves, and that some desired behaviors are more effectively implemented in the system than requested through prompting. We release the benchmark and more than 18,000 agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该研究将智能体视为可配置系统，在新基准上考察任务信息、推理、自我验证、时间预算和骨干模型五个配置维度，发现信息影响最大，配置间存在交互，且专用工具比提示更能改变验证行为。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估通常将智能体视为固定，仅报告成功率等指标，但实际中智能体是可配置系统，用户的选择会显著影响其性能与一致性，缺乏对配置维度的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建包含四个科学任务的新基准，要求编码智能体找到并正确操作已发表的专业模型；研究五个配置部分：任务信息、推理、自我验证、时间预算和骨干模型；分析运行间方差、各配置效应及交互作用，并基于轨迹对智能体行为分类。
AI.result: 约54%的结果方差来自重复相同配置；任务信息影响最大，超过时间预算和模型规模，同时降低成本并改善校准；配置间存在交互，额外时间仅在信息充足或模型足够强时有效；提示验证对验证行为影响甚微，而提供专用验证工具则显著改变行为。
AI.conclusion: 智能体应作为可配置系统本身进行评估；某些期望行为通过系统实现比通过提示请求更有效；发布基准和超过18,000条智能体轨迹。

title: Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting
summary: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

AI.tldr: 针对表格数据稀缺、分布偏移及验证集偏差下的增强与加权学习问题（AWL-CS），提出IGDPR框架，结合不变引导扩散与原型重加权。
AI.motivation: 工业应用中表格数据稀缺且不平衡、训练与部署间存在协变量偏移、验证集与测试环境不一致，标准生成模型仅模仿过时源分布，导致增强与适配流程不稳定。
AI.method: IGDPR包含两部分：i) 使用不变势引导扩散采样过程，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性；ii) 基于原型的重加权策略，通过结构聚类而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声。
AI.result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，该方法通过增强对鲁棒学习最有益的数据，提升了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: IGDPR统一了稳定合成与结构适配，有效应对AWL-CS中的生成误导和密度重加权不稳定问题，改善了鲁棒学习性能。

title: FedLore: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Learning via Shared Gradient Low-Rank Projection
summary: Federated training of foundation models is constrained by client memory and communication costs. LoRA-based methods reduce these costs through low-rank adapters, but their fixed rank budget can limit adaptation. Gradient low-rank optimization offers greater flexibility, yet independently chosen client subspaces create a problem we term \emph{subspace fragmentation}: local projections interact with data heterogeneity to bias aggregated directions, while aggregation can increase update rank and communication cost. Thus, accurate local gradient compression need not preserve global descent. We propose \texttt{FedLore}, which shares a low-rank optimization basis within each round and refreshes it across rounds. The shared basis enables exact aggregation in low-rank coordinates and eliminates the identified projection bias. Subspace refresh allows the accumulated model update to exceed the per-round rank budget. We characterize the aggregation bias and establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound for the projected-SGD variant under a global-gradient coverage condition and standard smoothness and variance assumptions, with bounded gradient heterogeneity. Experiments on vision and language tasks, including federated pre-training, show that \texttt{FedLore} outperforms the evaluated low-rank adapter baselines and matches or exceeds full-parameter training, while reducing communication and optimizer-state memory.

AI.tldr: 提出FedLore，通过轮内共享低秩优化基并跨轮刷新，解决联邦基础模型训练中的子空间碎片化问题，实现低秩坐标精确聚合与通信/内存节省。
AI.motivation: 联邦基础模型训练受客户端内存与通信成本限制；LoRA等低秩适配器固定秩预算限制适应能力，而梯度低秩优化中独立选择的客户端子空间与数据异质性交互导致聚合方向偏差（子空间碎片化），且聚合可能增加更新秩与通信成本，因此局部梯度压缩精度未必保证全局下降。
AI.method: FedLore在每轮内共享一个低秩优化基，并在轮间刷新该基；在低秩坐标下实现精确聚合以消除投影偏差，跨轮刷新使累积模型更新可超过单轮秩预算。理论分析刻画聚合偏差，并在全局梯度覆盖条件、标准平滑性与方差假设及有界梯度异质性下，为投影SGD变体建立O(T^{-1/2})平稳性界。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务（包括联邦预训练）上，FedLore优于所评估的低秩适配器基线，匹配或超越全参数训练，同时降低通信与优化器状态内存。
AI.conclusion: FedLore通过共享低秩优化基与跨轮刷新，有效缓解子空间碎片化，兼顾低秩通信内存优势与全局优化性能，为联邦基础模型训练提供高效方案。

title: Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在冻结的推理模型上，通过轻量级后训练和推理时优化，实现多令牌预测（MTP）的预期加速。
AI.motivation: 现有MTP模型（如MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）需在预训练阶段联合训练MTP头，消耗数万亿令牌，成本极高。作者探究是否仅通过后训练即可在冻结模型上达到类似加速效果，并优化服务时系统。
AI.method: 1) 在冻结的Qwen3-8B上，使用约2.5B令牌的简单交叉熵对K=3链式MTP头进行后训练；2) 提出链感知的草稿令牌验证松弛规则，允许与主干模型令牌分布有界漂移；3) 提出自适应控制器，在推理时动态选择激活的MTP头数量。
AI.result: 1) 后训练配方在数学、编程和知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B的预期加速，且MTP训练令牌数减少10^3-10^4倍；2) 验证松弛规则使每个基准的预期加速提升12-16%，同时保持任务准确率；3) 自适应控制器可恢复固定最大MTP草稿长度下11-14%的加速损失。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级后训练和推理时优化足以在冻结推理模型上实现高效MTP加速，显著降低训练成本，并通过验证松弛和自适应控制进一步提升性能。

title: Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking
summary: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动作分块（action chunking）中动作误差在开环与闭环执行下的传播规律，发现误差放大普遍、收缩罕见，且闭环重规划难以将放大转为收缩，主张显式训练闭环反应性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多以时间一致性、缩短决策视野、表示学习与误差累积等机制解释动作分块为何提升行为克隆策略性能，但缺乏对动作误差进入系统后如何传播的直接刻画。
AI.method: 在每个状态注入微小动作误差，分别在开环（重放剩余块、不重规划）与闭环（扰动后重规划）两种执行模式下测量误差增长或收缩速率，并拟合速率将状态标记为收缩、放大或不可分辨；在三个基准套件的十二个操作任务上评估；进一步分析拟合视野对速率估计的影响，并训练预测器从相机帧与本体感觉中恢复这些标签。
AI.result: 自信稳定的状态稀少，而误差放大在可分辨传播速率的状态中普遍存在；传播速率强烈依赖拟合视野，放大通常前置，短窗口会高估长视野传播；开环传播状态可仅由相机帧与本体感觉恢复，闭环传播仅部分可恢复，因其还取决于扰动后策略如何动作。
AI.conclusion: 仅用误差累积无法完整解释动作分块：被动开环动态与策略重规划都不能一致地收缩注入误差，重规划也很少将开环放大转为自信收缩；因此应通过面向扰动与树覆盖的训练显式训练闭环反应性，而非指望其从标准模仿学习中可靠涌现。

title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
summary: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对专家构建的智能体编程任务进行强化学习（RL），探究其能否解决编码智能体在最后一公里（如遗漏需求、测试不充分、破坏既有行为、依赖未验证假设）的失败，并验证学习成果能否迁移至训练分布之外。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常因最后一公里问题而失败：构建了大部分功能但遗漏需求、只测试实现已覆盖的案例、破坏应保持不变的既有行为，或基于未经验证的假设进行验证。研究旨在检验RL能否弥合这一差距及跨分布迁移能力。
AI.method: 对Kimi K2.7 Code（1T参数、32B激活的开源混合专家模型）仅用RL进行后训练，在1,700个任务上训练：1,000个仓库任务由隐藏的失败转通过测试和既有行为的通过转通过测试评分，700个终端任务由专家编写的隐藏验证器评分。奖励为目标检查通过的比例，若有任何通过转通过测试失败则奖励归零。使用秩为32的LoRA适配器进行一周期GSPO训练。
AI.result: 在六个外部基准、三种智能体框架下，pass@1均提升：SWE-Bench Pro（60.1→64.8）、DeepSWE（31.0→43.4）、Terminal-Bench 2.1（67.4→82.0）、Terminal-Bench 3（1.4→12.1）、Terminal-Bench 4（0.0→7.6）、SWE-Marathon（5.0→25.0）。在五个独立任务集上汇总改进显著（p<0.001），且在训练数据收集后发布的三个任务集上仍显著（p=0.004）；在训练中未使用的两种框架下也均有提升。DeepSWE和Terminal-Bench 3的中位轨迹在智能体步骤上缩短24-35%。基础模型失败的DeepSWE运行多为接近成功，而在新解决的任务上，配对轨迹显示模型避免了上述四种失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 仅用RL在专家构建的智能体编程任务上后训练，能显著提升编码智能体的性能，并迁移至训练分布之外的新基准和未见的智能体框架，同时缩短轨迹并避免典型失败模式。

title: CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement
summary: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.

AI.tldr: 提出CoEvolve框架，将视觉定位分解为显式状态构建与状态编辑，通过区域演化强化和双向去噪精炼器实现可诊断、可编辑的定位过程。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉定位模型将目标识别、空间推理和边界估计压缩为单一终端预测，自由形式的推理虽使推理语言化但缺乏可测量、可编辑的空间状态，导致中间定位错误难以诊断和纠正，错误区域选择和不精确边界会保留在最终框中。
AI.method: CoEvolve包含两个核心组件：Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER)将定位分析组织为渐进式语义-空间轨迹，每个推理步骤确定显式候选区域；Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR)将推理文本视为固定语义上下文，通过双向同位置重建精炼轨迹的坐标场。几何和行为级目标提供目标几何和编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注校正。
AI.result: 在自然图像和遥感定位评估中，9B骨干的CoEvolve在定位精度上媲美高达241B参数的模型。在受控损坏下，单次BDR通过将平均框重叠率提高超过27个百分点，展现出对显著定位错误的强恢复能力。状态源比较进一步支持显式状态构建与源匹配编辑的互补性。
AI.conclusion: CoEvolve通过分离状态构建与编辑，实现了可诊断和可纠正的视觉定位，显著提升定位精度和错误恢复能力，证明了显式空间状态与编辑机制的有效性和互补性。

title: Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Clock Diffusion框架，通过位置相关噪声调度实现半自回归连续扩散语言模型，并设计ClockDLMs及高效采样器Cache Grab，解决了连续扩散模型在变长生成和KV缓存上的局限，在多个任务上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型在离散数据生成上表现与离散扩散模型相当，但缺乏实际语言模型所需的关键功能：变长生成和键值缓存支持，且生成质量仍落后于自回归和离散扩散的前沿。
AI.method: 引入位置相关噪声调度定义半自回归连续扩散语言模型，提出Clock Diffusion框架（含块和滑动窗口生成两种特例），并基于滑动窗口训练ClockDLMs；进一步提出Cache Grab采样器，结合置信度阈值提交和自推测解码等加速推理技术。
AI.result: ClockDLMs在OpenWebText上达到扩散似然边界的最优，超过块半自回归离散扩散模型；在TinyGSM上训练后，于GSM8K基准上大幅优于连续基线，并匹配或超越可比的半自回归离散扩散模型；Cache Grab进一步提升了生成质量和效率。
AI.conclusion: Clock Diffusion通过位置相关噪声调度和高效采样，使连续扩散语言模型具备变长生成和缓存能力，并在似然和生成质量上达到或超越离散扩散模型，推动了连续扩散在语言建模中的实用化。

title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出原型引导的个性化量子神经架构搜索方法vFedProtoQNAS，通过类原型共享实现虚拟联邦学习，避免异构QNN参数聚合的语义不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 量子联邦学习中设备能力差异导致单一共享QNN架构不适用，个性化QNAS虽能选择设备特定QNN，但跨结构不同的QNN平均参数会混合语义不一致的电路操作。
AI.method: 各客户端独立搜索并训练专属QNN，从潜在表示计算类级本地原型，利用服务器全局原型作为联邦语义锚点进行细化；模型参数不跨客户端聚合，仅通过类原型共享实现协作。
AI.result: 实验表明vFedProtoQNAS相比FedAvg准确率提升3.70%，并增强类一致表示对齐。
AI.conclusion: 原型引导的个性化QNAS有效解决异构QNN聚合问题，提升量子联邦学习性能与表示一致性。

title: Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出DiDAE，将冻结的基础模型包裹在条件扩散解码器中，通过解纠缠字典的闭式编辑生成反事实，无需梯度，速度比SOTA快至2000倍，并在六个数据集上验证其反事实质量与下游分类器修复能力。
AI.motivation: 基础模型仍易受虚假相关和“Clever Hans”策略影响，而现有可解释机器学习方法虽能为无元数据的分类器发现并移除此类策略，但对基础模型尚无对应方案。
AI.method: DiDAE在冻结基础模型外接条件扩散解码器；反事实为沿解纠缠字典方向的闭式编辑后解码。字典可通过Procrustes监督学习或SVD、稀疏自编码器无监督获得，无需梯度。还提出反事实知识蒸馏（CFKD）修复下游分类器，并可用该机制对预训练字典与训练分类器进行排序，返回分类器实际读取的少数方向。
AI.result: 在六个数据集（两个合成、四个真实）上评估；其中三个数据集的需求驱动基准中，反事实与SOTA相当或更优，并通过CFKD修复下游分类器，优于基于元数据的校正；速度比SOTA快至2000倍。
AI.conclusion: DiDAE为无元数据基础模型提供即插即用的反事实解释与修复流程，可因果验证并纠正分类器依赖的虚假方向；配合公开字典与预训练解码器，仅需廉价的线性蒸馏与微调，已开源为Peal库。

title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练激活稀疏化方法TopK-Guided，结合token级稀疏度自适应与块级敏感度预算分配，在Llama-2/3上优于TEAL和WINA。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练方法存在权衡：阈值法（如TEAL）按token自适应稀疏度但无法严格控制实际稀疏度，TopK法（如WINA）固定稀疏度但所有token共用同一预算；且两者都忽略不同transformer块敏感度差异，对所有块使用相同预算。
AI.method: TopK-Guided将受限的token级稀疏度自适应与敏感度感知的块级预算分配相结合，无需训练。
AI.result: 在Llama-2和Llama-3模型上，TopK-Guided在困惑度和下游准确率上持续优于TEAL和WINA，同时保持与WINA基本相同的稀疏度相关投影计算量，高稀疏度下增益最大；消融实验表明两个组件提供互补改进。
AI.conclusion: TopK-Guided通过联合token级与块级稀疏度优化，有效解决现有方法局限，提升LLM推理激活稀疏化效果。

title: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
summary: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑生物推理模型通过后训练连接LLM与生物基础模型表示和文本后，其基准准确率能证明LLM对这些输入进行推理的假设，并发现多种模型中生物输入贡献有限。
AI.motivation: 现有生物推理模型将后训练后的基准准确率视为LLM对生物基础模型表示和生物文本进行推理的证据，但这一假设缺乏验证。
AI.method: 在DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务上测试六个生物推理模型；扰动一个生物输入而固定查询和其他输入；构建证据冲突，将一个基因组、蛋白质或细胞的基礎模型表示与另一个的文本配对；对语言模型接收的表示拟合线性探针；分析推理轨迹与生物输入的关系。
AI.result: Evo2和ESM3对BioReason和BioReason-Pro在评估任务上的性能贡献很小；打乱DNA序列几乎不改变BioReason疾病预测准确率，证据冲突中两模型分别有97.9%和99.7%的情况跟随文本；线性探针能预测任务目标，说明基础模型编码了相关信息但未提升整体性能；相反，基础模型输入对ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2和CellWhisperer性能有贡献，基因句子中的差异表达基因对Cell2Sentence-Scale性能有贡献；在BioReason-Pro的SFT和RL检查点及42个BioReason检查点中，准确率提升不意味着生物输入贡献更大；BioReason轨迹错误描述核苷酸变化，BioReason-Pro轨迹在证据冲突下描述最终预测中省略的功能。
AI.conclusion: 当前后训练策略不能确保基础模型表示对任务性能有贡献。

title: VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

AI.tldr: VideoEvolve 提出自动演化智能体框架，以提升基于冻结视频-语言模型的视频时序定位性能。
AI.motivation: 针对冻结视频-语言模型的智能体，其框架决定查询如何引导时序预测及预测如何细化；人工优化框架需诊断定位失败并协调工作流与指令修改，成本高且复杂。
AI.method: 提出 VideoEvolve 框架，采用保留阶段接口的 Cloze-Structured Harness Representation 表示框架，使智能体工作流与指令可演化；使用 Branch-Guided Harness Evolution 保留有潜力的代码分支，借助执行反馈引导局部编辑，并通过验证决定保留哪些改进。
AI.result: 在多个基准上提升时序定位性能；组件分析表明指令细化是稳定增益来源，而演化代码的收益因评估设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 自动框架演化是提升视频时序定位的有效方法，代码已开源。

title: Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $ρ=-0.90$; $ρ=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

AI.tldr: 提出入口状态锐化：在测试时强化学习（TTRL）前用无数据训练把通用检查点预置到更利于无标签自适应的状态。
AI.motivation: TTRL依赖模型自身采样生成监督信号，若入口策略熵高、概率分布弥散，自监督噪声更大，有限适应预算被用于集中概率质量而非表达已有能力，因此检查点入口状态至关重要。
AI.method: 从Qwen3-4B出发，用不同无数据目标得到五个入口状态检查点，在完全相同的15步TTRL协议下评估；以入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号，并以可达能力为约束，另做域内无标签自蒸馏干预。
AI.result: 入口策略熵强秩相关于端点转换效率（Spearman ρ=-0.90；控制入口可达性后ρ=-0.99）。R-Zero熵为3.39 nats，在MATH、GPQA、AMC的6/6配对比较中低于未调优基座；SPIRAL熵为0.07 nats，尽管自博弈阶段无数学数据，仍在MATH和GPQA取得最高TTRL后准确率。自蒸馏干预可有意锐化入口状态。
AI.conclusion: 应将检查点准备视为状态控制问题：用无数据训练提升TTRL就绪度，以入口熵为无标签控制信号、可达能力为约束。

title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
summary: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it.
